title: Advanced Compute Specialist (Chips), UKGI Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
AWS Public Sector is hiring a specialist to build the go-to-market plan for custom silicon across UKGI (UK, Germany and International Organisations). You will define the market, shape the proposition, and drive adoption into government workloads at a time when sovereign AI infrastructure and national-scale compute programmes are creating unprecedented demand for custom silicon (Trainium, Inferentia, Graviton, Nitro) and GPU.

Near-term, you will support our account teams to win GPU and Graviton deals. Longer-term, you will develop the strategy for positioning AWS-designed chips into infrastructure programmes where public sector organisations want to own on-premises compute as a national asset. This is a new role with no established playbook - you will build it from scratch.

You will work directly with Annapurna Labs (the team behind AWS custom silicon), UK government programme leads, and account teams across Defence, Intelligence, Central Government, and Research to connect real customer demand to the next generation of AWS chips.

The ideal candidate is excited about the incredible opportunity silicon innovation presents in the industry today and is deeply passionate about working with great teams that deliver the highest quality services. You are naturally customer obsessed and thrive in a fast-paced environment that requires strong technical and business judgment and solid communication skills.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and own the Advanced Compute pipeline for UKGI: identify, qualify, and progress opportunities for Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia, and GPU across UK public sector accounts.

- Develop the go-to-market strategy for AWS silicon in sovereign and on-premises contexts.

- Support account teams on active GPU deals - providing technical positioning, commercial structuring, and deep market expertise.

- Build the demand signal from UK government: aggregate requirements and translate customer intent into product roadmap input.

- Develop customer-facing propositions around confidential computing on Graviton, on-premises silicon deployment, and sovereign AI compute.

- Work with Public Policy to position AWS silicon within broader government policy and frameworks such as the UK AI Hardware Plan.

- Bridge hardware and software, translate silicon performance capabilities into customer-facing value propositions and product requirements that span the full solution stack

- Build relationships with senior technical and commercial decision-makers at C-suite level.

A day in the life
You split your time between progressing active GPU opportunities with account teams and building the longer-term Chips go-to-market plan. A typical week might include briefing an account team on Graviton positioning for a department migration, joining an internal call with silicon teams to relay UK government compute requirements, drafting a customer proposal for confidential compute on Trainium, and meeting a programme director at a government department to discuss AI research infrastructure options. You report directly to the Head of Customer Acceleration and work closely with Solutions Architects, Specialist Sellers, and the Public Policy team.

About the team
The AI, Emerging Tech & Customer Acceleration team is the specialist engine supporting UKGI account teams. Our job is to find new markets, bring deep technical and commercial skills into the biggest deals, and accelerate the time between opportunity and outcome for UK public sector customers.

- Experience engaging and influencing senior executives
- Experience working within UK Defence, Intelligence, Research or Critical National Infrastructure organisations

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations
Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Visit this page to find more information on each of our building types. https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/facilities

Please note we are not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

This posting encompasses all openings in the country. Site placement is matched by aligning your location preferences with location availability after your interview. Relocation benefits are offered at time of offer to eligible candidates.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit this page to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers.
https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits


Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.
Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.
Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.
End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

Basic qualifications

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a bachelor’s or master’s degree. (You must have all degree requirements met before your first day).

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's program for Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.

title: Applied Science Manager , Amazon Music Catalog Quality
descriptionHtml:
The Music Catalog Quality team at Amazon Music serves a key role in developing solutions to ensure and improve the quality of catalog metadata and content across the music streaming experience. We create solutions that detect, measure, and remediate quality issues in music metadata - including artist information, track attributes, versions, content tags, and provide actionable insights that enable continuous improvement of the catalog. We leverage a host of scientific and engineering technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and automated data validation pipelines.

As an Applied Science Manager on the team, you will lead a team of scientists to define and execute a transformative vision for holistic catalog quality measurement, metadata enrichment, and content integrity. Your team will own the science solutions for foundational quality detection frameworks, metadata validation and correction technologies, state-of-the-art algorithms to identify and resolve catalog anomalies (violative content, duplicative/low value content, misattributed tracks, incorrect metadata), and/or agentic AI solutions that help internal teams quickly surface and fix quality issues to ensure customers receive accurate, complete catalog experiences.

Key job responsibilities
You independently manage a team of scientists. You identify the needs of your team and effectively grow, hire, and promote scientists to maintain a high-performing team.

You have a broad understanding of scientific techniques, several of which may fall out of your specific job function.

You define the strategic vision for your team. You establish a roadmap and successfully deliver scientific solutions that innovate on catalog quality detection, metadata enrichment, and content integrity.

You define clear goals for your team and effectively prioritize, balancing short-term quality improvements and long-term innovation in catalog intelligence.

You establish clear and effective metrics and scientific process to enforce consistent, high-quality artifact delivery and measurable catalog quality improvements.

You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks. You know when to escalate.

You communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences. You author strategic documentation for your team. You communicate issues and options with leaders in such a way that facilitates understanding and that leads to a decision.

You work successfully with customers, leaders, and engineering teams. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues.


About the team
We are a team of scientists and MLEs focused on music catalog quality and metadata intelligence. You will work with colleagues with deep expertise in ML, NLP, CV, Gen AI, and data quality systems with a diverse range of backgrounds. We partner closely with top-notch engineers, product managers, content operations teams, and other scientists with expertise in music metadata, content classification, and building scalable modeling and software solutions that keep the Amazon Music catalog accurate, complete, and trustworthy.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- Knowledge of ML, NLP, Information Retrieval and Analytics
- 6+ years of applied research experience
- Knowledge of machine learning approaches and algorithms
- 3+ years of programming in Java, C++, Python or related language experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers
- 5+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) organization is seeking a Senior Executive Assistant to support the Global Vice President of Workplace Health and Safety. title: Sr. Certification Designer, Data Center Certifications
descriptionHtml:
Are you an accomplished certification designer ready to shape the future of data center workforce credentialing through rigorous exam development, psychometric excellence, and data-driven program innovation across AWS’s global Data Center Communities?

AWS Data Center Learning’s mission is to develop the best data center workforce on Earth. The organization is responsible for providing training, certification, and career development pathways to all new and existing AWS data center employees worldwide. Our team is constantly looking to optimize the experience and provide our operations teams with a work-ready, credentialed workforce.

Our Certification team is seeking a Senior Certification Designer who moves beyond traditional assessment design and leads collaborative job-task analysis workshops to blueprint and build industry-leading certification programs. In this role you will act as a credentialing strategist, psychometric practitioner, and empathetic designer, partnering with cross-functional teams to build certification ecosystems that span exam development, item writing, blueprint design, credential management, and certification pathway architecture. This position requires consistent collaboration with Senior Leaders in Data Center Operations, Safety, Security, Logistics, Planning, Delivery, and other teams to design and deliver valid, reliable, and defensible certification programs. You will consult with technical subject-matter experts, apply psychometric principles and emerging technologies, and use data-driven iteration to produce certification experiences that drive measurable workforce capability outcomes.

We are looking for a professional who designs and delivers innovative certification solutions at scale. The ideal candidate will have proven mastery of exam development methodologies, job-task analysis, item writing best practices, psychometric principles, and credentialing standards (such as ISO 17024 or equivalent). You must be able to manage multiple complex certification projects simultaneously, mentor fellow designers, and drive the future certification development roadmap. The ideal candidate demonstrates ownership of outcomes, thinks big about scalable credentialing solutions, dives deep into psychometrics and operational challenges, and maintains the highest standards while moving fast to meet business needs.

As the Senior Certification Designer, you will represent our organization across Data Center Communities. This entails translating organizational competency frameworks into actionable certification strategies that balance rigor and agility: modular, scalable exam architectures that adapt to evolving workforce needs. Your role will require communicating at all levels of the organization, working with senior leaders, and building relationships across global time zones and geographies.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and manage end-to-end certification programs—from exam blueprinting and item development through field testing, standard setting, and credential maintenance.

- Facilitate job-task analysis workshops and apply competency-mapping principles to create defensible certification blueprints.

- Lead item writing workshops, guiding SMEs in developing high-quality exam items (multiple choice, scenario-based, performance-based) aligned to blueprint domains.

- Apply psychometric techniques (classical test theory, IRT, item statistics, standard-setting methodologies) to ensure exam validity and reliability.

- Use performance analytics and candidate feedback to iterate on exam design, optimize item banks, and demonstrate program quality.

- Lead cross-functional certification projects in matrixed environments, mentoring junior designers and raising credentialing standards.

- Design scalable, modular item banks and certification architectures supporting multiple credential levels, roles, and geographies.

- Manage the full certification lifecycle and communicate strategy alignment with senior leadership across Global Data Center Operations.

A day in the life
Your morning kicks off with a little detective work—diving into item bank analytics and pass/fail dashboards, hunting down those sneaky underperforming items with lousy discrimination indices or bias flags waving for attention. Next, you'll pop into strategic meetings with senior leaders from Data Center Operation, playing translator between "here's what's breaking in the field" and "here's what our certification roadmap needs to fix." By mid-morning, you're running a job-task analysis workshop with subject-matter experts—think: sticky notes flying, task criticality debates getting spicy, and knowledge requirements taking shape for a shiny new data center operations credential. After lunch (fuel up, you'll need it), you're leading an item writing jam session—coaching SMEs on crafting scenario-based questions that actually make people think, red-penning drafts for technical accuracy, and making sure everything maps back to those all-important blueprint weightings. Your afternoon? It's a choose-your-own-adventure: maybe you're wrangling a standard-setting panel for an updated cert form, geeking out over item-level psychometric reports with a senior psychometrician or teaming up with the learning experience crew to make sure prep resources and exam objectives are best friends. Through it all, you're the person holding the big picture and the fine details—making sure every certification that ships is valid, reliable, defensible, equitable, and actually measures the stuff that matters most for the workforce.

About the team
Our mission is to develop the best Data Center workforce on Earth. The AWS Data Center Certification team sets the trusted standard that empowers the world's most skilled data center workforce. We create rigorous, scalable certification programs that validate that builders within Data Center Operations demonstrate the technical competencies needed to work safely, securely, and effectively. The team designs credential pathways that span a builder’s entire career journey: from foundational role-based certifications and safety credentials to advanced operational qualifications for tenured employees. Our certifications provide individuals with meaningful, portable credentials and provide the organization with a verified, defensible record of workforce capability. Our work directly underpins the safety, availability, and operational excellence of AWS’s global data center infrastructure.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Technical Training, Design, or a related field
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5+ years of with Learning & Development and course facilitation experience
- Experience applying concepts of learning science, educational psychology, and instructional design principles to learning solutions
- Experience developing or delivering training programs across multiple sites or regions
- Experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems, or experience in profee auditing, coding, and documentation requirements
- Demonstrated mastery of job-task analysis methodologies and the ability to facilitate SME workshops that produce defensible, competency-aligned certification blueprints.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Technical Training, Design, or a related field
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience with graphic training systems, multimedia content creation, and Learning Management Systems (LMS) administration
- Experience mentoring trainers, using data analytics for training effectiveness measurement, and leading change management initiatives
- Professional certification in credentialing or assessment (e.g., Certified Credentialing Specialist (CCS), Certified Assessment Designer, or equivalent).
- Master’s degree or equivalent in Educational Measurement, Psychometrics, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Instructional Technology, or a closely related field.

title: Area Manager, Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.



Key job responsibilities
- Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
- Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of cutting-edge vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree, or Associate's degree or above
- Relevant experience in people management
- Relevant experience of communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including your peers and leadership
- Relevant experience in using data or anecdotal evidence to influence business decisions
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and local language

- Experience working in another logistics environment

title: Quality Assurance Engineer, Prime Video Sports
descriptionHtml:
Love sports? Want to change the world? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Rolland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. Every day we face the challenges of a fast-paced market and expanding technology set. And we're building at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded-owner, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling new experiences to our customers. If this sounds like the type of experience you'd like to help build - apply here and let's chat!

Who we are:
We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. To do this we need to deliver best-in-class live sports infrastructure, testing, monitoring, and operations to optimize the delivery of live sports experiences at scale. Our team engineers for speed, quality, availability, and scale. As Prime Video has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. With AI as a transformative force, we're at an inflection point that enables us to unlock new opportunities in predictive analytics, automated defect analysis and mitigation, and automated operations that were previously beyond our reach.

What we're looking for:
We are looking for an experienced QA engineer to drive manual and automated testing within Prime Video Sports across a broad technology stack. This role involves deep involvement on projects from design to development & deployment. In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to the future of the Prime Video Sports customer experience. Successful candidates for this position demonstrate ability to multi-task, quickly adapt to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, create reliable/maintainable automated tests, find creative and scalable solutions to difficult problems, and ability to communicate clearly and concisely both written and orally. If you are the one that’s excited about entrepreneurial thinking, creating technology solutions for complex problems we want to hear from you.

What you will do here:
You will work with groups such as Product Management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will also work with Software Development Engineers to understand features and technical implementation. In this role, you will be responsible to deliver manual/automated solutions to test customer facing features. You will be empowered to choose the right highly scalable and available technology to solve complex problems in software quality assurance.

What you will get from us:
A great team to work with and the chance to build at a proven top tier company. You will get a startup like culture with the stability of an established industry leader. You will get support and resources from some of the smartest people in the industry to continue learning.

Key job responsibilities
1. Test Planning and Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive test plans for new features and product releases.
2. Bug Identification and Resolution: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify, document, and resolve software defects.
3. Automation tooling: Develop, extend, and maintain automated tests on iOS, Android, Web, and Living Room Clients to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
4. Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure a seamless integration of quality throughout the development lifecycle.
5. Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in retrospectives and contribute to process improvements to enhance overall product quality.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience in manual testing
- Experience in automation testing
- Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in API & Mobile testing
- Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

title: ProServe Partner, Programs, ProServe Partner Organization
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

Would you like to be part of a team that is redefining the Cloud industry by driving measurable AWS revenue growth through strategic partner-led customer acquisition? Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) has identified a $137M incremental ARR opportunity in thousands of existing AWS customers with high-growth attributes who have never had a ProServe engagement. We are looking for a world-class PPO ProServe Account Executive to own and drive our partner ecosystem in generating and converting this pipeline at scale.

As a PPO ProServe Account Executive within the ProServe Partner Organization (PPO), you will own and drive the strategic relationships and operational cadence with select Partners in our partner network such as Accenture, EPAM, Deloitte, Slalom, Thoughtworks, Kyndryl, and Effectual. The Program leverages Partner reach and scale to generate ProServe pipeline from a curated cohort of ~6,800 high-growth-potential AWS customers. You will drive partner accountability for account coverage, pipeline creation, opportunity progression, and conversion. This is a strategic partner management, pipeline generation, and deal acceleration role, not a cloud delivery role.

This role reports directly to the Sr. ProServe Partner Leader, and operates within the ProServe Partner Organization (PPO). This Program uses a programmatic, wave-based coverage model leveraging AI-powered Sales Agents, GenAI-powered account intelligence, and ProServe Investment to systematically convert high-DSI-potential customers into ProServe engagements. You will be the connective tissue between these partners and AWS driving strategic alignment, ensuring account assignments are actioned, pipeline is building, feedback loops are tight, velocity targets are met, and escalations are resolved with minimal oversight.


Key job responsibilities
• Own and drive the strategic and operational relationships with select partner organizations (I.e. Accenture, EPAM, Deloitte, Slalom, Thoughtworks, Effectual) responsible for generating pipeline across ~6,800 accounts.
• Drive partner accountability for account coverage commitments, pipeline creation targets, opportunity progression, and conversion to ProServe engagements.
• Co-sell directly alongside partners on partner-originated opportunities. Once a partner identifies and qualifies a customer need, join discovery calls, shape the ProServe solution proposal, and present the AWS value proposition to customer decision-makers.
• Own the ProServe deal through closure on partner-sourced opportunities (prime or sub): once partners originate and qualify pipeline, take ownership of opportunity progression from qualified stage through SOW execution, MSA creation (if necessary) navigate internal AWS approvals (legal, investment committees), and drive deals to booking.
• Lead customer-facing conversations on ProServe commercial constructs once partners have opened the door. Articulate Fixed Price packaging, investment models, and engagement value to C-suite and VP-level buyers alongside the partner account teams who originated the opportunity.
• Orchestrate cross-functional deal support on partner-originated deals by engaging ProServe Solution Architects, Delivery Leads, and Pricing teams to accelerate deal velocity and remove technical or commercial blockers before they stall progression.
• Coordinate with existing AWS Account Teams (ProServe PAEs, Account Managers, and Technical Account Managers) on partner-originated opportunities where target accounts roll up to parent accounts already covered by established AWS teams. Ensure alignment on customer engagement strategy, avoid conflicts with in-flight motions, and leverage existing account relationships to accelerate deal progression.
• Own the wave-based account assignment strategy: design and optimize account distribution to partners, manage the 30-day review cycle, analyze coverage gaps, process returned accounts, and reassign for maximum coverage and conversion.
• Design, lead, and continuously iterate on partner cadences (weekly pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews) to track progress, remove blockers, and accelerate deal velocity.
• Leverage AI-powered Sales Agent outputs and GenAI-powered account intelligence to equip partners with account-specific sales plays, customer research, and propensity-to-buy signals that accelerate their prospecting.
• Own end-to-end pipeline reporting and analytics across the partner ecosystem: accounts contacted, opportunities created, pipeline TCV, conversion rates, and velocity against the 200 new-logo target.
• Own and govern ProServe Investment allocation for partner-led opportunities, ensuring compliance with the adjusted 1x ARR-to-Investment guardrail and tracking payback period.
• Proactively identify high-performing partner motions, systematize best practices, and drive adoption across the partner ecosystem. Surface patterns in partner feedback to inform program iteration.


A day in the life
As a PPO ProServe Account Executive, you will be the operational hub connecting AWS and our partner ecosystem. Your days will include running pipeline review cadences with partner leads, analyzing account coverage and conversion data, distributing AI-generated account intelligence to partners, coordinating account assignments and reassignments, tracking partner progress against velocity targets, and removing blockers that slow deal progression. You will lead across a select set of partners simultaneously, each with different working styles, geographic strengths, and specializations.

The ideal candidate will possess strong strategic partner management skills, exceptional operational rigor, executive-level communication, and the ability to influence without authority across multiple external organizations. You should have a demonstrated track record of independently owning complex partner programs, driving pipeline outcomes, and holding senior partner stakeholders accountable in a co-sell environment. You will be comfortable working in a programmatic, data-driven environment where GenAI tools accelerate account research, and where success is measured by pipeline creation velocity, partner coverage rates, and ultimately, new ProServe customer acquisition that drives downstream AWS spend growth.


About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:

• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.

A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.

Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.

Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.

About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:

• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:

Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:

title: Account Consultant , Financial Deduction Vendor Consultant Program
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is the most customer-centric company. In the light of this, the company is offering our vendors the highest level of services, encouraging them to participate to grow their businesses on Amazon.
The Financial Deduction Vendor Consultant Program (FD VCP) works with Amazon AVS Retail Vendors and internal stakeholders who are facing supply chain defects that lead to financial deductions. The service provides a dedicated support aimed to identify and sustainably resolve the defects causing financial deductions. We are seeking a Financial Deductions (FD) Consultant to join our team.
The FD Consultant is a strategic role that combines financial analysis, vendor management, and process optimization responsibilities. This professional manages a portfolio of companies within the VCP FD program, focusing on provinding investigation findings, improving financial metrics such as ISR, PPV, Chargebacks, Vendor Returns etc. through data-driven analysis and proactive vendor engagement. They serve as an essential bridge between vendors and internal stakeholders, conducting deep-dive analyses of financial data, leading vendor-facing Kaizen sessions, and implementing improvement plans while maintaining strong relationships with all stakeholders involved. The role demands expertise in financial operations, data analysis, and stakeholder management, as they work to optimize processes, develop automation initiatives, and provide mentorship to team members. Through their comprehensive understanding of financial deductions and vendor operations, they enhance vendor experience (VX) while ensuring operational excellence and driving continuous improvement across the organization.


Key job responsibilities
Business Impact
Manage and optimize the FD VCP program vendor portfolio, focusing on key performance metrics such as ISR, PPV, Chargebacks etc. Implement preventive measures and action plans to drive vendor performance while enhancing overall vendor experience. Streamline interactions between vendors and internal teams to improve efficiency and support quality.
Dive Deep, Data Analysis & Reporting
Conduct comprehensive financial data analysis to identify deduction patterns and root causes through thorough auditing and utilization of internal systems. Prepare and distribute detailed reports to all levels of stakeholders, ensuring effective communication of findings and insights.
Stakeholder Communication
Cultivate strategic relationships with internal and external stakeholders to gain a deep understanding of vendor financial deduction metrics and activities. Lead Kaizen sessions, manage cross-functional communications, and handle escalations while providing regular updates to vendors and senior management. Represent the team in project reviews and operational meetings, delivering data-driven presentations and supporting internal teams in financial metric performance.
Operations & Process Excellence
Independently execute and optimize financial deductions processes while identifying and implementing tactical solutions for operational challenges. Drive continuous improvement initiatives, develop comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and actively participate in Correction of Error (COE) processes. Support quality audits and spearhead efficiency improvements across operations.
Team Support
Provide mentorship and training to new team members, fostering their professional growth and development. Support talent acquisition efforts and manage resource allocation and capacity planning to ensure optimal team performance and efficiency.
Process Improvement & Innovation
Design and implement small-scale automation initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity improvements. Conduct systematic analysis to identify upstream issues and develop process improvements aligned with organizational goals. Support the launch of new programs, categories, and features to foster innovation and growth.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 2 years of experience in Account Management
- Strong stakeholder communication and relationship management skills
- Proficiency in data analysis and business metrics

Preferred qualifications

- MBA or Master's degree in Business or related field
- Experience in e-Commerce or retail/vendor management
- Ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- Work flexible shifts including nights, weekends, or holidays in a 24/7/365 environment
- -2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- -2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a data center or mission critical facility (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.)
- Industrial-scale chiller plant operation
- Primary/Secondary loop systems
- Plate and frame heat exchanger maintenance

title: Finance Manager, Fleet Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building one of the world's most advanced delivery fleets — and we need a bold finance leader to help shape its future. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role driving investment strategy across a large-scale global fleet infrastructure.

As Finance Manager for WW Fleet Infrastructure Finance, you will serve as the strategic finance partner to one of Amazon's most consequential infrastructure organizations. You'll own the financial frameworks that guide major infrastructure investment decisions — evaluating, funding, and scaling the physical and operational assets that power last-mile delivery at a global scale.

This role is for a builder and a strategic thinker who thrives in ambiguity, influences at the senior level, and brings rigor and creativity to complex investment decisions.

Why you'll love this role:

- Direct ownership of investment strategy across a large-scale global fleet infrastructure asset base
Partnership with teams at the forefront of Amazon's delivery innovation
- Cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Data Science, and Sustainability
- Work that matters — your models and recommendations influence significant annual capital decisions


Key job responsibilities
- Own financial planning and investment evaluation frameworks for fleet infrastructure, including accruals, variance analysis, and monthly close processes
- Partner with business stakeholders to identify risks, evaluate financial impacts, and influence decisions that improve outcomes and reduce costs
- Work across diverse data sources to identify quality issues, drive root cause analysis, and implement solutions
- Improve, automate, and standardize finance processes to increase efficiency and scalability
- Communicate complex financial topics clearly to varied audiences and lead projects that streamline reporting and planning

A day in the life
In this role, you sit at the center of consequential infrastructure investment decisions. Your primary stakeholders are WW Vehicle Infrastructure senior leaders, and your value is in translating complex financial data into clear strategic direction — giving leadership the confidence to commit capital, course-correct, and prioritize at scale.

A typical day might include:

- Advising senior leaders on infrastructure investment trade-offs, bringing financial rigor to decisions that shape Amazon's long-term delivery capabilities
- Developing and stress-testing investment frameworks that evaluate cost structures, risk profiles, and return potential across a large, complex asset base
- Driving monthly close and variance analysis — and more importantly, turning those results into forward-looking insights that inform planning and resource allocation
- Partnering with Engineering, Procurement, Data Science, and Sustainability to ensure financial strategy is embedded in operational and technical decision-making
- Building scalable, automated reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real-time visibility into a global fleet asset base
- Preparing executive-level materials that distill complexity into clear narratives and actionable recommendations
The problems you'll solve are strategic in nature — how to allocate capital across competing infrastructure priorities, how to build financial frameworks that scale with the business, and how to ensure that investment decisions are grounded in rigorous, forward-looking analysis.

About the team

title: Data Center Technician , DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for Data Center Technicians to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Technicians are the primary resolver and troubleshoot and solve a range of datacenter infrastructure issues including, but not limited to: hardware, fiber, networking, and related problems. You will be part of the Data Center Operations (DCO) team, overseeing the operation and maintenance of the IT infrastructure and hardware for data centers in AWS Cloud regions. You will become the primary resolver for your support team, and gain troubleshooting skills on different hardware and software cases. You will be able to troubleshoot and solve most infrastructure issues and engage other appropriate solutions groups on more complex problems to drive solutions..



Key job responsibilities
• SAFETY

Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and diligently encourage a world-class safety culture. Own the safety initiatives and projects to foster a strong safety culture.

• DATA CENTER OPERATIONS (DCO)

This position involves:
- Diagnosing hardware and network problems followed by physical repairs
- Troubleshooting events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Performing root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Manual handling and lifting of equipment may be required (weight limits in accordance with regulations)
- Working rotating shifts (morning/night) as well as weekends to maintain the 24/7 data center environment

A valid (EU) driving license is required as Data Centers may not have any public transportation available nearby.

Location Requirements:
Our data centers are located in remote areas where access via public transport may be limited. Therefore, a valid EU driving license is required for this role.

Work Schedule:
This is a 100% onsite in-person position due to the hands-on nature of managing mission-critical infrastructure and data center industry.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll be working on our advanced ticketing system, managing a diverse workload and solving complex server hardware issues.

You'll be part of a collaborative team that keeps our cloud infrastructure running smoothly, responding to both automated directives and team leadership with exceptional time management and adaptability.

Your expertise in problem ticket tracking and escalation procedures will be crucial as you consistently meet and exceed Amazon's high standards for technical proficiency and operational excellence. This role is vital in maintaining the efficiency and reliability of our sophisticated data center infrastructure – you'll be working and supporting the face of Cloud technology in the region.

We're looking for skilled technicians with a passion for technology to help us expand our Cloud to the next level.

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Sr. PCBA Manufacturing Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

As a Sr. Aerospace Manufacturing Engineer for one or more Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBA), you'll be directly responsible for bring engineering designs for complex electronic assemblies to reality. You'll work closely with the Design Engineering and Supplier Manufacturing teams to ensure new designs are optimized for manufacturing while driving improvements in yield, cycle time, and cost for existing hardware. Your expertise will be invaluable in bringing satellite hardware to life.

Come solve the difficult and rewarding engineering challenges in developing a highly reliable, power efficient, performant, low-cost satellite bus and payload. As a Sr. PCBA Manufacturing Engineer, you will work across design engineering, supply-chain, quality, and our manufacturing partners to drive Amazon Leo electrical sub-system and PCBA manufacturing and delivery.

You must have the ability to dive deep on the details to identify, understand and solve difficult technical problems and also utilize a system level approach to prioritize issues for whole program. You use data to drive manufacturability, reliability, and quality objectives in design and development teams.

*Up to 25% Travel will be required for this role

Key job responsibilities
-Partner with the Design Engineering teams to drive Design for Excellence (DFx) by providing PCB/PCBA DFM and DFA feedback to identify and mitigate PCBA manufacturing challenges early in product development.

-Own the PCBA Manufacturing Qualification process at the contract manufacturer by defining manufacturing readiness requirements and leading key milestone reviews to ensure all production readiness deliverables are complete.

-Investigate and develop new manufacturing technology and methodologies to enhance PCB and PCBA quality, reliability, throughput, and cost.

-Drive closure of all operational issues during pre-production builds. Work within Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, and Reliability Engineering to implement and optimize manufacturing processes and improve yields for production ramp.

-Investigate failures/defects in manufacturing, test, and integration. Identify and mitigate underlying root causes to prevent reoccurrence as part of continuous improvement efforts.

-Identify opportunities for risk reduction and simplification of PCBA manufacturing processes.

-Deliver manufacturing processes capabilities including equipment capability, quality controls, materials characterization, and standardized rework practices.

-Actively monitor the success of products and processes through production ramp. Provide regular status reports of PCBAs progress from design to production.

-Deploy and qualify polymerics (staking, underfill, and conformal coat) processes for high volume production.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production.
- 5+ years of experience in PCBA/PCB manufacturing engineering.
- Experience with driving DFx, DFM, DFA for NPI and mass production.
- Experience in board assembly processes: stencil, paste print, SPI, pick & place, SMT reflow, AOI, AXI, selective solder, flying probe, and wash.
- Experience working independently and ensuring timely and accurate communication with contract manufacturers, suppliers, and 3rd party test and failure analysis partners.
- Ability to lead small teams in root-causing technical product manufacturability and process problems and drive implementation of solutions.
- Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, enthusiasm for the team’s spirit of innovation and mission of improving manufacturability, quality, and reliability in cutting-edge technology.

Preferred qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in PCBA/PCB supply chain, manufacturing or engineering.
- 5+ years’ experience with industry standard PLM and DFX systems, Mentor/Valor preferred.
- Experience performing Design and Process Failure Modes and Effects Analyses.
- Experience with IPC-A-610 Class 3, IPC J-STD-001 compliance
- Experience in solder alloys including leaded and lead free as well as next gen low temp alloys.
- Experience leading Design of Experiments.

title: Duales Studium - BWL
descriptionHtml:
Ein Job im Operations-Bereich bei Amazon versetzt dich ins Zentrum dessen, wie Dinge vom Klick bis zur Haustür gelangen. Du hilfst dabei, Systeme zu entwerfen, zu verbessern und zu betreiben, die Menschen, Produkte und Orte miteinander verbinden – und das in großem Maßstab. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Teams zusammen, um reale Herausforderungen zu lösen, und siehst die direkten Ergebnisse deiner Entscheidungen, wenn sie täglich bei den Kunden ankommen. Hier ist die Wirkung dessen, was du aufbaust, nicht abstrakt – sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam – und hält eine der komplexesten Betriebsorganisationen der Welt am Laufen. Hier nimmt deine Reise Gestalt an – durch Handeln, Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, in viele Richtungen zu wachsen Dein Einstieg in die Führung - Das Duale Studium bei Amazon
- Studiengang: BWL / Logistikmanagement (B.A.)
- Studienpartner: IU Internationale Hochschule (30+ Standorte deutschlandweit)
- Programmbeginn: 1. August 2027
- Dauer: 3,5 Jahre
- Einsatzorte: mehr als 20 Amazon-Standorte in Deutschland (Fulfillment Center und Sort Center)
Das duale Studium bei Amazon ist ein strukturiertes Führungsentwicklungsprogramm, das dich Schritt für Schritt auf eine operative Führungsrolle vorbereitet. Wer das Programm erfolgreich abschließt, hat die Chance direkt eine Position als Area Manager:in in unserem Netzwerk zu bekommen - ohne weiteres Bewerbungsverfahren.
________________________________________
Drei Phasen auf dem Weg zur Führungskraft
Das Programm ist in drei aufeinander aufbauende Phasen gegliedert, die deinen Verantwortungsbereich kontinuierlich erweitern.
Phase 1 - Operative Grundlagen: Zunächst lernst du die operativen Abläufe im Fulfillment Center von Grund auf kennen, analysierst Kennzahlen und setzt eigenständig Projekte zur Prozessverbesserung um.
Phase 2 - Rotation & Führungsentwicklung: Anschließend rotierst du durch verschiedene operative Bereiche, übernimmst schrittweise Führungsaufgaben - von der Begleitung der Team Leads über Schichtplanung bis hin zur Personalsteuerung - und entwickelst ein Verständnis für bereichsübergreifende Zusammenhänge.
Phase 3 - Area-Manager-Niveau: In der Abschlussphase arbeitest du auf Area-Manager-Niveau: Du steuerst operative Kennzahlen, führst Teams eigenständig und trägst echte Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

Das bieten wir dir
• Karriereperspektive: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Programms wechselst du direkt in eine Area Manager Position im Amazon-Netzwerk - ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren
• Studienfinanzierung: Amazon übernimmt die Studiengebühren an der IU
• Mentoring: Strukturierte Begleitung durch Learning Manager:in und operative Führungskräfte
• Netzwerk: Zugang zu einem europaweiten Operations-Netzwerk
• Mobilität: Kostenloses Deutschlandticket
• Verpflegung: Bezuschusste Mahlzeiten am Standort
• Mitarbeitervorteile: Vielfältige Vorteile, wie ein Amazon Mitarbeiterrabatt
• Technologie: Arbeite täglich mit modernster Automatisierungs- und Robotiktechnologie

Key job responsibilities
• Analyse und Optimierung operativer Prozesse in Fulfillment- und Sortierbereichen
• Eigenständige Durchführung von Continuous Improvement Projekten mit messbaren Ergebnissen
• Übernahme von Führungsaufgaben im Rahmen von Lead-Rotationen (Schichtverantwortung, Teamsteuerung, KPI-Management)
• Mitarbeit an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten in den Bereichen Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Personalwesen und Technik
• Vorbereitung auf die eigenständige Steuerung eines operativen Bereichs als Area Manager:in
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem internationalen Team innerhalb des europäischen Amazon-Netzwerks

A day in the life
Deine Betreuung im Programm
Du bist nicht allein. Während des gesamten Programms wirst du von zwei Seiten unterstützt:
• Dein:e Learning Manager:in am Standort begleitet dich durch alle drei Phasen, ist deine zentrale Ansprechperson und koordiniert deine Entwicklung
• Operative Führungskräfte mentoren dich während deiner Rotationen und geben dir direktes Feedback aus der Praxis
Zusätzlich bist du Teil einer deutschlandweiten Community dualer Student:innen - ein Netzwerk, das mit dir wächst.

________________________________________
Dein Alltag: Theorie und Praxis im Wochentakt
Das Studium läuft parallel zur Praxis - keine langen Blockphasen, sondern ein wöchentlicher Rhythmus:
• 2 Tage Studium an deinem IU-Standort (Logistik, Supply Chain, BWL, Personalführung)
• 2-3 Tage / 20 Stunden im Amazon Fulfillment Center oder Sort Center

Du bist kein Besucher im Betrieb. Du bist Teil des Teams - von Tag eins an.

Basic qualifications

- Allgemeine Hochschulreife, Fachhochschulreife / fachgebundene Hochschulreife
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1-Niveau)
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Affinität für das Fach Mathematik
- Umgang mit MS-Office (insbesondere Kenntnisse in Excel, Word und PowerPoint)

Preferred qualifications

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität"
- Interesse, Führungsverantwortung zu tragen

descriptionHtml:

They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience

title: Software Development Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. These Sellers offer hundreds of millions of unique products providing a broad and diverse inventory of products from Books, Electronics and Apparel to Consumables and beyond. Fulfillment By Amazon enables Sellers to provide fast and efficient delivery to their customers using Amazon fulfillment services which stores, packs, ships and provides customer service for seller products. Sellers now make up the majority of the business on Amazon.com. The FBA team is responsible for the science, business, and operations of the core systems, algorithms, and seller-facing tools and workflows of the FBA service. These enable FBA sellers to enroll selection, plan and inbound product, and manage and action inventory in Amazon fulfillment network - managing through the full inventory lifecycle. FBA Capacity Management and Planning organization builds and manages tools worldwide for FBA capacity allocation, market-driven additional limit system, capacity management in emerging countries, inventory planning and forecasting, and the north-star seller-facing metric, the Inventory Performance Index.Our systems are built entirely in-house, and are on the cutting edge for automating large-scale business, inventory planning and optimization. This role might be for you if…

You have designed, refactored, re-architected, deprecated and/or implemented large-scale cloud-based distributed services with millisecond latency and ultra-high transactional volumes.
You have experience implementing best practices in improving team coding culture subjected related to quality and/or security

In this job, you will…
Experiment with whatever technology we need to get the job done.
Use Lean Software Development concepts such as Agile, Scrum and Kanban.
Use Test-Driven Development and Continuous Deployment.
Work with Senior and Principal Engineers, Researchers, and Data Engineers across multiple teams to design a new platform for optimizing supply chain management
Expand and optimize our world-class supply chain systems to support a variety of emerging business initiatives.
Automate third party supply management systems and break new ground to drive inventory across Amazon marketplaces.

descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations
Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful — keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As an entry-level Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you will be provided with extensive safety training and develop into an exceptional safety leader.

You'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

descriptionHtml:

The leader will manage a multi-disciplinary team comprising product managers, program managers, business intelligence engineers, and sales operations professionals, while working as a key partner to GS ROA market leaders to shape the Global Seller Experience — driving Seller growth and success through innovative productized services, AI-powered solutions, scalable programs, data-driven insights, and effective go-to-market strategies.
The ideal candidate combines strong product/program management expertise with a deep understanding of AI/GenAI technologies and their application to business operations. They should thrive in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment serving multiple markets and time zones; demonstrate proficiency in both leveraging AI tools for operational excellence and developing AI-powered products that make Sellers and internal teams work more effectively; have proven experience influencing cross-org global stakeholders; and demonstrate strong people leadership capability to build, develop, and inspire a high-performing team.

Product Strategy & Program Management
