title: Software Development Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the infrastructure that every AWS service depends on before it can start? The AWS Secrets Management team builds and operates the system that distributes credentials and certificates to AWS's internal service fleet. The system sits on the critical path for service startup, runs across every host in the fleet, and has zero tolerance for downtime. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will design and deliver backend services, APIs, and the host agent that powers credential distribution at massive scale. You will also lead migrations that modernize how credentials are stored and delivered, build AI-agent-driven operational tooling, and help bring the system up in new AWS regions. If you are a self-starter who thrives on solving hard distributed-systems problems with real, immediate impact, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement production backend services, APIs, and host-level agents in Java, Rust, C++, and Python that distribute credentials and certificates across AWS's internal fleet with high availability and zero downtime.
- Own end-to-end migrations of live, heavily depended-upon systems, preserving backwards compatibility while modernizing how credentials are stored and delivered.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated test coverage, and AI-assisted operational tooling — including agentic coding tools for triage and remediation — to keep a fleet-wide system operable at scale.
- Collaborate with security partner teams, product managers, and principal engineers on cross-team designs, participating in written design reviews and code reviews to ensure solutions meet security and reliability requirements.
- Drive operational excellence through metrics, alarms, incident response, and on-call rotations, identifying root causes and implementing permanent fixes to reduce operational burden over time.

A day in the life
Most of your time is heads-down: writing code, reviewing designs, and working through complex migration plans for systems that thousands of other services depend on. Collaboration is concentrated at key moments — design reviews where you present your approach, code reviews where you give and receive candid feedback, and incident response where your deep knowledge of the system makes you the person others turn to. You use AI-assisted engineering tools daily, both for coding and for operational triage, applying your judgment on when to trust their output.

About the team
The AWS Secrets Management team is responsible for credential and certificate distribution across AWS's internal service fleet. Our system is a dependency for a large number of AWS and Amazon services, which means the work we do is upstream of other teams' launches, migrations, and security commitments. We operate in an inclusive environment that values knowledge sharing and mentorship. Engineers each own an area of the system outright — serving as the required reviewer, the go-to person during incidents, and the one who sets its technical direction. We are focused on modernizing credential delivery and expanding into new AWS regions, and we are looking for engineers who are excited to shape that future.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. TIPM, Data Center Network Build, BaND
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Brick and Network Deployment (BaND) team is searching for a passionate and talented technical program manager to drive Data Center and Network Capacity planning in IAD. You will assess the demand requirements along with available network resources to determine and drive prime solutions for our customers. You will work with stakeholders to complete pre-requisites necessary to deliver critical networking capacity. You will lead programs with goals to improve infrastructure resource utilization and availability. You will work with teams across the AWS Organization to effectively plan and deliver data center capacity.

Key job responsibilities
- Monitor the network health, customer demand, anticipate risks, resolve issues and initiate corrective action as appropriate.
- Work with stakeholders (networking engineers/tech program managers/senior management) to define requirements and processes.
- Manage the dependencies and the interfaces between projects and negotiate the trade-offs needed.
- Provide program progress reporting on a regular basis.
- End to end responsibility for the program’s execution and success.
- Manage multiple competing projects/programs simultaneously.
- Develop and implement scalable, data-driven process improvement/automated solutions.
- Keep the customer experience as the primary focus.
- Meets/exceeds Amazon’s leadership principles requirements for this role

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Support Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is investing heavily in building a world-class advertising business, delivering a collection of self-service products that drive discovery and sales, and we are responsible for ensuring that Advertisers and Partners can easily navigate our products and services. The Partner Tech organization builds innovative software solutions and owns the customer experience for Advertisers and Partners integrating with our API and MCP. Our products are strategically important to Amazon's Retail and Marketplace businesses, driving long-term growth. We deliver billions of ad impressions and millions of clicks daily and are breaking fresh ground to create world-class products. We are a highly motivated, collaborative organization with an entrepreneurial spirit and bias for action. With a broad mandate to experiment and innovate, we are growing at an unprecedented scale with a seemingly endless range of new opportunities.

Are you passionate about driving customer success and learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? Amazon Advertising is seeking Support Engineers to help external customers build business-critical applications on our Advertising API. You will represent Amazon as you investigate technical issues, work with API developers to ensure compliance with our program policies and identify gaps in our technical solutions as well as patterns of API misuse. You will own development of processes and prevention strategies to improve the developer experience. Working directly with Advertising API engineers and the onboarding team, you will ensure customer issues are resolved quickly and effectively.


Key job responsibilities
Support Engineers troubleshoot, debug, evaluate, and resolve system-generated alerts, make feature enhancements and bug fixes, manage systems and hosts, perform software deployments and migrations, and automate routine operational tasks. The position requires strong troubleshooting, technical, and communication skills, and includes a mix of on-call responsibilities, operational tasks, and software development work. You will develop tools and automation to drive toward human-free operations.
This role is ideal if you are passionate about creating, integrating, and leveraging tools to minimize operational overhead — without compromising best-in-class customer service. We want our services to be as autonomous as possible, and that requires engineers who think big, simplify complex problems, and relentlessly pursue the best customer experience. Our environment is built for engineers who flourish in building automation to reduce operational workload rather than simply performing operational tasks.
Successful candidates will join an elite Advertising API support team, provide troubleshooting and operations support, and innovate to replace manual tasks with scripts and code.

- Provide solutions to product and API-related questions raised through partner engagements, serving as an escalation point for complex technical issues
- Identify key product architecture components, and propose and build solutions that unblock partner integrations
- Write code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the developer community
- Audit partner behavior to ensure compliance with program policies
- Lead root-cause analysis on systemic and recurring issues, and drive architectural recommendations to engineering teams
- Mentor Support Engineers and lead knowledge-sharing initiatives across the team
- Own end-to-end process design for support workflows, from identification through implementation and measurement
- Analyze support trends at scale to provide data-driven product feedback and influence the engineering roadmap
- Work with customers to understand how they use our services, and provide feedback to development teams to improve the onboarding experience
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication during critical events; author post-incident reviews and present findings to leadership
- Drive projects that improve support-related processes and the overall developer support experience

Basic qualifications

- - 3–6 years of experience in technical support or software development
- - Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- - Experience working with REST API-based services
- - Experience working with SQL
- - Experience designing or building support tooling and automation frameworks

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development
- Experience with REST web services, XML, and JSON
- Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Java, C++, Python)
- Linux/UNIX operating system knowledge
- Knowledge of AWS or other cloud technologies
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
- Understanding of support processes — ticketing, monitoring, and metrics
- Experience with data analysis to identify trends and drive operational improvements
- Track record of influencing product or engineering decisions through support insights
- Please apply with resume in English

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical

title: Software Engineer II, Fintech
descriptionHtml:
If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/

About Us:

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role
Twitch's Enterprise Platform & Technology (EPT) organization is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build the systems where SAP meets AWS — extending our enterprise ERP with cloud-native services and agentic AI to power Finance and enterprise functions across Twitch and Amazon. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll work on SAP-side development (ABAP, CDS, RAP, OData) and AWS-native engineering (Lambda, Step Functions, MCP servers, Bedrock, CDK) — owning integrations end-to-end.

You'll work at the intersection of SAP enterprise systems and modern cloud engineering — building AWS-hosted APIs and pipelines that talk to SAP, standing up agentic AI tooling (MCP servers, Bedrock agents, Claude-powered workflows) that automates Finance operations, and shipping production AWS services alongside SAP customizations. The business problems are well understood; how you solve them with SAP + AWS + AI is up to you. We're looking for an SAP developer whose toolkit has grown past the ERP — someone who writes ABAP inside SAP GUI and is just as ready to pick up Python or TypeScript to ship the cloud half of their own integration, and who raises the bar on automation along the way.

You Will:
Build in SAP

- Design, build, and maintain integrations between SAP (S/4HANA, BTP) and downstream systems — owning the full lifecycle from design through operations
- Write ABAP, SAP HANA SQL, and CDS views to implement business logic, reports, and data transformations within the SAP ecosystem
- Design, build, and maintain SAP APIs — OData services (SEGW / RAP), RESTful APIs, SOAP web services, and RFC-based interfaces — for consumption by external systems, Fiori apps, and AWS-hosted middleware

Extend it with AWS and agentic AI
- Build and operate AWS-native services (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate, Amazon ECR) that extend SAP capabilities beyond the traditional ERP boundary
- Deploy and manage the AWS infrastructure behind your integrations using CDK (TypeScript/Python) — including CI/CD pipelines, IAM roles, VPC/VPCE connectivity to SAP, and multi-environment topology (beta/gamma/prod)
- Design, build, and ship agentic AI systems on top of your SAP APIs — MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, Bedrock-based agents, and Claude-powered workflows — that automate Finance operations like reconciliations, reporting, variance analysis, and payout workflows
- Build data pipelines that move financial data between SAP, Redshift, and enterprise applications

Cross-cutting
- Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and Tax stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions delivered across SAP and AWS
- Own production systems end-to-end — deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iterative improvement
- Improve engineering practices on the team through code reviews, documentation, and mentoring


Perks
* Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
* 401(k)
* Maternity & Parental Leave
* Flexible PTO
* Amazon Employee Discount

About the team
Twitch's Enterprise Platform & Technology (EPT) organization is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build the systems where SAP meets AWS — extending our enterprise ERP with cloud-native services and agentic AI to power Finance and enterprise functions across Twitch and Amazon. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll work on SAP-side development (ABAP, CDS, RAP, OData) and AWS-native engineering (Lambda, Step Functions, MCP servers, Bedrock, CDK) — owning integrations end-to-end.

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience working with REST API based services and experience with automation and any version control tools
- SAP:
- 4+ years of hands-on SAP development experience (ABAP, HANA SQL, CDS views, BTP, or SAP integration technologies like BAPIs, RFC)
- Experience building integrations using File-Based and API-Based (REST, OData, SOAP) patterns
- Experience with the S/4HANA top-down development approach — CDS views (with associations, annotations, parameters) and AMDP classes to push data processing to HANA from the ABAP layer
- AWS and AI
- Hands-on experience with AWS services (Lambda, S3, Step Functions, DynamoDB, IAM, API Gateway, or similar) — deploying and operating production workloads
- Proficiency in at least one modern language beyond ABAP — Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java — with a demonstrated track record of shipping production code
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation) — writing, deploying, and reviewing IaC in a team setting
- Demonstrated heavy use of AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Bedrock, or similar) integrated into your daily engineering workflow — code generation, data analysis, automation, and problem-solving
- Shared
- Experience testing and debugging APIs using tools like Bruno or Postman — building request collections, handling authentication flows, and validating response contracts
- Understanding of OAuth 2.0 authorization flows (authorization code, client credentials) and OpenID Connect (OIDC) for securing API integrations
- Strong understanding of object-oriented design patterns (Factory, Strategy, Observer, Template Method) and SOLID principles
- Finance domain knowledge — familiarity with FI/CO, FI/CA, AP, AR or GL

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building AI-powered automations or agentic workflows in production — MCP servers, Bedrock agents, LangGraph, or similar
- Experience building Fiori applications using the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP) — including business object definition, behavior implementation (managed, unmanaged, or hybrid), and service binding/exposure

title: Senior Engagement Manager, AWS AI Engineering (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Software engineering is where AI is changing work fastest. Almost every developer now uses AI coding tools, yet only a minority of engineering organizations see meaningful gains from them. The AWS AI Engineering team exists to close that gap. We help AWS customers systematically build better software with AI, and we aspire to be the team builders worldwide turn to when they want to do exactly that.

This is a big opportunity to have impact. You will join at the point where AI-native development is moving from early adopters to the enterprise, working with some of the largest organizations in EMEA as they change how they build software.

As our Senior Technical Customer Solutions Manager, you will be the coordination hub for every AI engagement routed to the team across EMEA: qualifying inbound requests, assigning owners, keeping engagements moving from first contact to launch, and being the single point of contact that account teams and customers rely on for status. Your work does not end when a workshop is delivered: you own what happens next, making sure the customer turns what they learned into lasting change in how they build software. You will apply your program management expertise and technical fluency so that our AI Engineers can spend their time building and delivering.


Key job responsibilities
You will work with customers, account teams, solutions architects, AI engineers, partners and a broad community of AWS practitioners on some of the most challenging AI adoption problems today. You will:
- Own intake: qualify new requests, assess each customer's readiness and make sure every engagement has a named owner.
- Drive engagements end to end as the single point of contact for customers and account teams on progress, risks and outcomes.
- Meet customer executives and engineering leaders to agree business outcomes, and stay with the customer after the workshop until those outcomes are achieved.
- Run the team's operating rhythm and own its operational metrics.
- Reinvent how the team works with AI. You will not manage engagements through spreadsheets and status boards; you will use AI agents and automation to take manual work out of intake, staffing and follow-up, so every engagement takes less effort than the last.
- Stay hands-on: run demos and immersion days, and join workshops alongside practitioners.
Travel within EMEA may be required up to 25% of the time.

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing new requests with an AI engineer and deciding the right path for each. Later you meet a customer CTO to agree what success looks like after their workshop, and follow up with an account team whose customer's adoption has stalled. You lead the team's weekly planning, and in between you improve one of the agents that handles routine follow-up, so there is less to chase next week.

About the team
Our flagship program is AI-DLC, the open-source, AI-native software development lifecycle that we created and continue to evolve with customers. We also lead AI-DLC Discovery, which helps product and business stakeholders decide what to build now that the time and cost of building have fundamentally changed, alongside offerings that give AI agents a deep understanding of large codebases and step customers towards autonomous software delivery.
We work from first principles and anchor everything on customer outcomes: measurable, lasting improvements in speed, quality and economics.

AI moves fast, and so do we. Our offerings evolve as the technology does, and you will thrive here if you enjoy adapting quickly and are comfortable with ambiguity.

Basic qualifications

- Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion
- Experience in enterprise IT, either as a vendor, consultant or have prior experience working with or managing technical programs
- Experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
- Experience leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- AWS or other cloud certification
- Knowledge of the software development/engineering lifecycle from conception to delivery or IT lifecycle
- Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or equivalent
- Familiarity with the AI ecosystem: foundation models and the providers behind them, agent frameworks, coding assistants and the tooling customers use to build AI applications, and how enterprises move AI from experimentation to production
- Experience with pipeline management, customer satisfaction tracking and business review reporting

descriptionHtml:
The Design Program Manager supports the delivery of EU Amazon Logistics (AMZL) design initiatives within Amazon's Global Building Design and Engineering (GBDE) team. The role coordinates cross-functional workstreams, contributes to building design standards for AMZL EU and sub-programs, and ensures programs are executed with precision and pace. Working within established frameworks, the role supports cross-regional initiatives to ensure EU standards are globally informed and transferable. The ideal candidate combines technical grounding in the built environment with strong program coordination skills, operates effectively in ambiguous environments, and brings cross-regional curiosity that enables benchmarking to raise the quality of EU standards.

Key job responsibilities
- Coordinate cross-functional workstreams to support the end-to-end delivery of EU AMZL design initiatives, ensuring programs are executed with precision and pace
- Contribute to the development and documentation of building design standards for EU AMZL and sub-programs, working within established frameworks
- Support cross-regional and cross-program initiatives to ensure EU design standards are globally informed and transferable across Amazon's logistics network
- Manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, bringing structure and clarity to complex, multi-stakeholder environments
- Qualify, track, and drive design change proposals through the standards governance process, aligning stakeholders and monitoring outcomes until changes are adopted
- Produce clear, data-driven documentation and communications in English, and present findings to senior stakeholders
- Conduct cross-regional benchmarking by leveraging curiosity about other markets and cultures to identify transferable design and cost efficiencies
- Travel across the EU up to 30% of the time to support program delivery, site reviews, and stakeholder engagement

A day in the life
Indicative - You start by reviewing active EU AMZL initiative status, identifying blockers and aligning priorities. You connect with engineering, construction, and operations partners across time zones to move proposals forward and keep delivery on track. Mid-morning, you review design change proposals or prepare documentation to drive stakeholder alignment. In the afternoon, you translate technical decisions into clear, structured standards outputs for EU teams to adopt. You close with a cross-regional check-in, drawing on benchmarking insights from other markets to sharpen EU program recommendations. No two days are identical, but every day moves something forward.

About the team
Amazon's Global Building Design and Engineering (GBDE) team defines and maintains the physical infrastructure standards behind one of the world's most complex logistics networks. Operating across multiple regions — including North America, Europe, and International (covering markets such as LATAM and India) — GBDE works at the intersection of design, engineering, and program delivery, translating strategic direction into standards that scale across hundreds of facilities globally. The team collaborates closely with construction, operations, and technology partners to ensure standards are rigorous, globally informed, and continuously improved through cross-regional benchmarking and alignment.

- Experience with operations/supply chain

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Alexa Finance, Alexa Finance
descriptionHtml:
Drive the Financial Strategy Behind One of Amazon's Most Transformative Businesses

Amazon's Alexa organization is redefining how hundreds of millions of customers interact with technology — and we need a Senior Financial Analyst on our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team who wants to be at the center of it. This isn't a back-office finance role. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution — owning the financial planning, forecasting, and analytical frameworks that guide how Alexa invests, grows, and scales. From building the models that shape OP cycles to delivering variance analyses that change the conversation in leadership reviews, your work will have direct, measurable impact on one of the fastest-growing businesses in Amazon's portfolio.

What You'll Do
Own the Planning Cycle End-to-End — Lead the financial planning and forecasting processes (OP1, OP2, monthly/quarterly guidance) for your business area, building high-fidelity models that translate strategic ambitions into actionable financial plans with robust checks and balances.

Deliver Actionable Variance & Performance Analysis — Go beyond reporting the numbers. Conduct deep-dive variance analyses (actuals vs. plan, month-over-month, year-over-year), identify the why behind the trends, and surface insights that drive corrective action and inform forward-looking decisions.

Partner as a Strategic Finance Advisor — Work directly with business leaders and senior executives as a trusted thought partner — not just a number provider. Translate financial data into strategic narratives that influence investment priorities, resource allocation, and long-range planning.

Build & Maintain Scalable Financial Models — Design and own sophisticated P&L, revenue, and cost models that support scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and business case development. Your models will be the foundation for decisions worth millions.

Drive Cross-Functional Alignment — Collaborate with product, engineering, marketing, and operations teams to ensure financial perspectives are embedded in business decisions. Own the bridge between operational metrics and financial outcomes.

Elevate the FP&A Function — Identify opportunities to automate, streamline, and improve existing planning and reporting processes. Bring a continuous improvement mindset to how the team operates — think mechanisms, not just deliverables.

What Makes This Role Special
Strategic Seat at the Table — FP&A at Alexa isn't a support function; it's a strategic partner. You'll have regular visibility with VPs and Directors, and your analyses will directly shape how the business allocates capital and prioritizes investments.
Impact at Scale — Alexa touches hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. The financial frameworks you build will influence how Amazon invests in AI, voice technology, and the next generation of ambient computing.

Intellectual Depth — This is a business that thrives in ambiguity. You'll tackle complex, undefined problems — from emerging revenue streams to evolving cost structures — where the right financial lens can unlock entirely new ways of thinking.

Growth Trajectory — The Alexa business is evolving rapidly, creating abundant opportunities for expanded scope, increased ownership, and career acceleration within Amazon Finance.

What We're Looking For
A self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and sees undefined problems as opportunities, not obstacles

Strong FP&A fundamentals — you're fluent in planning cycles, P&L management, variance analysis, and financial modeling
Exceptional Excel/financial modeling skills with a keen attention to detail and a commitment to high-fidelity outputs

Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority workstreams simultaneously (OP cycles, monthly closes, ad-hoc analyses) without sacrificing quality
Strong interpersonal and communication skills — you can distill complex financial narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, and you're comfortable presenting to senior leadership

Experience building scalable processes and mechanisms, not just one-off analyses
Intellectual curiosity and a genuine passion for understanding what drives business performance at a unit-economic level

- 3+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 3+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience

Our finance team serves as a strategic partner to this rapidly evolving organization, driving the financial rigor behind decisions that impact network design, technology investments, and operational efficiency at massive scale.

TTS FP&A seeks a Finance Manager to join our team, partnering directly with senior business and finance leaders to own strategic financial planning and drive decision-making across the organization. You will have extensive cross-functional partnership opportunities with leaders spanning engineering, operations, product, and program management to solve high-visibility, high-impact, unstructured problems as we scale our transportation technology portfolio. Your ability to deliver meaningful financial leadership through ambiguity and operate with a high degree of critical thinking will position you as a trusted finance partner influencing the strategic direction of TTS.

Success in this role requires you to lead and influence business owners, maintain a high degree of integrity, respectively audit and challenge business model assumptions, and adapt to a rapidly evolving environment. You will own the financial strategy behind TTS's operating expenditures and technology entitlements and hold yourself and your partners accountable for ensuring data-driven decisions are best for Amazon. You bring best-in-class business partnership, financial expertise, and high judgment not only in the execution of your work but also while advocating strong controllership within your team and across stakeholders. You are comfortable leading strategic discussions, communicating insights to senior leadership, and presenting financial narratives during business reviews. You think two steps ahead, prioritize building scalable processes the right way, and appreciate rigor in process as much as excellence in execution

Key job responsibilities
Partner with senior business leaders to provide strategic financial guidance, build analytical frameworks for new initiatives, and assess return on investment for technology and infrastructure opportunities across TTS.

Own core financial processes including month-end close, annual operating plans, long-range strategic planning, and OP1/OP2 cycles while ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with internal and external policies.

Dive deep to build complex analyses, models, and narratives with broad scope that deliver measurable results and directly influence strategic direction for the organization.

Identify and implement large-scale financial solutions to proactively improve, scale, or simplify finance tools, technology, and processes, driving automation and standardization across the FP&A function.

Translate complex financial data into clear, actionable business narratives for senior leadership, effectively challenging assumptions and providing sound recommendations that shape investment decisions.

Manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment, operating as the primary finance stakeholder in high-visibility decisions impacting TTS's technology investments and operational spend.

Mentor and elevate the financial capabilities of peers and cross-functional partners by establishing best practices, sharing analytical frameworks, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

A day in the life
Your day begins reviewing key financial metrics and preparing for a business review with TTS leadership to discuss operational performance, investment trade-offs, and planning assumptions. Throughout the day, you work on deep-dive analyses addressing high-priority business questions, partner with engineering and product leaders to align on financial implications of technology roadmaps, and drive improved planning and control mechanisms across the organization. You participate in strategic planning sessions where your financial expertise directly shapes investment decisions, and you spend time collaborating with peers on analytical best practices to ensure the team delivers best-in-class financial partnership to our stakeholders.

About the team
We are the FP&A team supporting TTS. Our team owns central reporting, planning, and goal-setting for the organization, including operational expenditures and technology entitlements. We serve as strategic financial partners, providing data-driven insights and financial leadership that guide decision-making across all levels of TTS.

Our team values financial rigor, proactive business partnership, and continuous process improvement. We take pride in translating complex data into actionable insights that drive organizational performance at scale. This role directly impacts decisions on significant technology and operational investments. A successful candidate effectively influences senior business partners, provides sound and thoughtful recommendations leveraging deep financial knowledge and critical thinking, and thrives managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. If you are passionate about financial strategy, analytical problem-solving, and delivering high-impact results in a collaborative environment, this is the role for you.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT)  - Platform Engineering & Services
descriptionHtml:
Ever wondered how Amazon keeps hundreds of fulfillment centers running at peak performance across the globe? That's where our team comes in.

We build the real-time data platform that gives Amazon's fulfillment network end-to-end visibility — from conveyor belts and robotic systems to software applications and workforce operations. Think of it as the central nervous system for Amazon's physical logistics: we ingest millions of data points per second from equipment and systems across 100+ facilities worldwide, store years of historical data without sacrificing query speed, and serve it all up through dashboards, APIs, and SDKs that help teams detect problems before they happen, optimize processes in real time, and make smarter decisions about how to move packages faster.

What makes this role different:

This isn't a typical web services role. You'll work at the intersection of physical operations and cloud-scale software — solving problems where hardware unpredictability meets distributed systems challenges. The data you help collect and serve directly impacts whether a package gets delivered on time, whether equipment gets serviced before it breaks, and whether an entire facility runs smoothly on its busiest day of the year.

You'll own problems end-to-end, from system design through production operations, and your work will be visible in real-world outcomes across Amazon's global logistics network.

Key job responsibilities
You'll design and build distributed systems that operate at massive scale — processing high-velocity time-series data streams, building storage layers that balance performance with cost, and creating APIs that make complex data accessible to thousands of users. Right now, we're in the middle of a major storage architecture migration, rethinking how we handle hot data to improve reliability and reduce latency. You'll also have the opportunity to work on data ingestion pipelines that collect signals from industrial hardware, robotics, and software systems — and turn that raw telemetry into actionable insights.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Propulsion Functional Technician, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. The Propulsion team is seeking a Manufacturing Functional Technician to join the team to support production manufacturing of future flight hardware.

The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will work within the Amazon Leo Propulsion Manufacturing Team supporting the build and integration of electric propulsion subsystems, including feed systems, thrusters, cathodes, PCBAs, tanks, and the integrated propulsion system.
This technician will be knowledgeable across multiple manufacturing process paths, perform troubleshooting activities, support training programs, and lead process improvement initiatives within their scope. The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing experience with flight hardware and thrives in a fast-paced production environment.

Additional Requirements:

Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position

Able to lift-up to 25lbs. unassisted

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

The starting pay for this role in Washington State is up to $33.50 / hour and employees are eligible for incremental raises based on tenure. This information is provided per the Washington State Pay Transparency Act. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via Amazon’s internal or external careers site.



Key job responsibilities
Assemble, fabricate, and process materials into complex manufactured products across propulsion subsystems per engineering documentation and SOPs, following one or more defined process paths.

Learn to perform troubleshooting activities associated with manufacturing products, observing, receiving, and obtaining information from all relevant sources to assist in debug and root cause analysis. Seek guidance when deviation from available procedures is needed.

Learn to perform hardware inspections and document discrepancies. May assist with development stage assemblies and first article builds under guidance of senior peers.

Read, interpret, and work from engineering documentation and drawings following well established processes.

Provide engineers with feedback on tooling, consumables, debug observations, and process issues through structured channels such as MES WOT entries.

Identify training needs for the team and assist in the training of new hires and junior peers to help them scale in their role.

Contribute to process improvement ideas within your project scope, working with leaders and engineers individually or in group settings.

Follow best practices as defined by leaders, lead techs, manuals, and SOPs. Meet productivity and quality standards consistently.

Uphold job and site safety standards and operations protocol. Follow proper procedure when quality or safety issues occur.

Attempt to resolve individual work blockers before escalating. Identify additional tasks once assigned work is complete and communicate to Lead Technician before proceeding.

Utilize MES and SAP systems for production tracking, traceability, and work order documentation. Capture and record data accurately in applicable systems.

May assist with servicing, repairing, calibrating, regulating, fine tuning, and testing machines, devices, and equipment.

Attend all relevant technical trainings offered by the organization.

A day in the life
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will perform a variety of hardware manufacturing, testing and integration tasks across propulsion subsystems to ensure hardware meets production requirements for flight. They will work closely with engineering teams to provide feedback on processes and identify improvements.
This technician is expected to be knowledgeable across multiple process paths, support peers and new hires, and lead process improvements within their scope. They will utilize MES and SAP systems for daily production tracking and traceability and will actively support the team in resolving work blockers and general operational needs.
A successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced, start-up-like environment and can apply their technical expertise and commitment to quality to positively impact team metrics and organization goals. To be successful they will need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while showing the highest standards of execution.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Propulsion Team is responsible for the design and development of the propulsion system which provides maneuvering capability to the spacecraft. The Propulsion Team is made up of a variety of sub-teams which are responsible for various aspects of the development process, such as mechanical design, systems engineering, subject matter experts, manufacturing, and test. This integrated team structure allows direct communication and rapid process feedback while also promoting close collaboration across the team.

- 2+ years of hands-on work experience with electro-mechanical assemblies, final integration and/or harness integration experience
- 2+ year’s experience in a fast-paced production environment with flight hardware
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with precision torque, measurement and inspection devices (i.e., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters, etc.)

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Partner Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads Partner Solutions brings partner technology integrations — across the Ads API, Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud, and Amazon Marketing Stream — to market. As a Technical Program Manager (TPM), you own the programs and mechanisms that move partner integrations from scoping to launch at predictable speed and quality. You run the cross-pod launch calendar, own intake and exit for prototyping/co-build engagements, and define the metrics and operating cadences (WBR inputs, time-to-integration, reuse) that leadership uses to steer the portfolio. You turn a set of independent partner builds into a coordinated pipeline — identifying critical path, clearing cross-org dependencies across Product, Engineering, Partner Development, and the pods, and escalating with judgment. You own named programs with explicit launch goals, measured on time-to-integration and throughput.

Key job responsibilities
- Own named launch programs end to end, each with defined scope, milestones, and measurable launch goals.
- Run the cross-pod launch calendar, sequencing partner integrations and identifying critical path across teams.
- Own intake and exit for prototyping/co-build engagements, enforcing entry criteria, timebox, and handoff.
- Define and report the portfolio's operating metrics — time-to-integration, throughput, reuse, WBR inputs.
- Drive cross-org dependencies to closure across Product, Engineering, Partner Development, and the pods.
- Run the operating cadences and mechanisms (reviews, swim-lane coordination, status narratives) that keep programs on track.
- Identify and mitigate program risks before they become launch blockers; escalate with sound judgment.
- Streamline or eliminate excess process, standardizing how integrations move through the pipeline.

A day in the life
Customers: the partner pods (M1–M3) and their SAs, whose integrations the TPM sequences to launch; partners benefit through faster, more predictable delivery.

Internal stakeholders: Solutions Architects and pod managers, Amazon Ads Product & Engineering, Partner Development Managers, the Principal SA (prototyping/Gen AI intake), and leadership (WBR/program reviews).

Problems solved: integrations stall on cross-team dependencies and unclear critical path; launches slip without a shared calendar; prototyping work lacks disciplined intake/exit; leadership lacks reliable time-to-integration metrics.

Daily: run program and launch cadences, track critical path, unblock cross-org dependencies, manage intake/exit, maintain the metrics, and report program status and risk.

About the team
The Amazon Ads Partner Solutions team enables partners to build and scale innovative advertising technology solutions. Working with customer data platforms, systems integrators, agency holding companies, independent agencies, ad servers, and retail media platforms, this global team designs and delivers technical solutions that drive partner success. The team combines deep advertising technology expertise with Amazon's latest capabilities, including AI-driven features, to help partners build scalable, secure, and performant solutions. Through technical leadership and close collaboration with product teams, they influence both partner solutions and Amazon Ads product development, driving innovation across the advertising ecosystem.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design
- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps

Preferred qualifications

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)

- - Experience managing intake/exit for prototyping or co-build engagements.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

This role will be physically based at our new MDD Pecos, TX site.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic dexterous manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction. This role presents an opportunity to shape the future of robotics through innovative applications of the latest software and AI tools for robots.

At Amazon we leverage advanced robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve complex operational challenges at an unprecedented scale. Our fleet of robots operates across hundreds of facilities worldwide, working in sophisticated coordination to fulfill our mission of customer excellence.

We are building the brains of our next-generation robots - a stack that:
- Enables deployment of robots at Amazon scale
- Enables unprecedented generalization across diverse tasks
- Seamlessly integrates with large models and optimal control techniques
- Integrates with human-safe safety solutions

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on our on-robot software team, you will design and build the software that runs on our robots and turns perception, planning, control, and machine learning models into reliable behavior on real hardware. You will partner with applied scientists and hardware engineers, lead designs across teams, and help set the technical direction for your area. Relevant backgrounds include perception, SLAM and navigation, controls, autonomy and task execution, and real-time robotics software, as well as experience deploying learned behavior models such as vision-language-action (VLA) models or VLM- and LLM-based planners on robots.

Join us in building the next generation of intelligent robotics systems that will transform the future of automation and human-robot collaboration.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design and delivery of on-robot subsystems, such as perception, SLAM and navigation, dexterous manipulation, low level controls, or task execution, from architecture through deployment on robots, and guide the engineers building it with you
- Prototype quickly with applied scientists, then take the algorithms and learned models that work to production components that meet the robot's real-time, compute, and safety constraints on embedded GPU platforms
- Define the interfaces, timing, and data contracts between perception, planning, control, and the learned policies that run alongside them
- Make your components observable with metrics and telemetry, and lead system-level debugging of failures seen on real robots
- Lead design reviews for the team and partner teams, and write documents for both technical and non-technical audiences
- Mentor engineers on the team in robotics and software engineering, and raise the bar for how we build, test, and operate robot software

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Bachelors or Master's degree and 10+ years in CS, ME, EE or related field experience
- Experience with robotics middleware like ROS, ZCM, or Zenoh
- Experience designing and shipping software for physical robots or other real-time embedded systems, with deep expertise in at least one robotics area such as perception, SLAM, navigation, controls, or autonomy

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience taking robotics algorithms or machine learning models from research prototype to production on real hardware, in close partnership with applied scientists
- Experience with mobile manipulation, locomotion, or dexterous manipulation
- Experience integrating learned policies on a real robot (e.g., imitation or reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, LLM-based task planning)
- Experience with real-time systems, including scheduling, deterministic timing, and sensor synchronization
- Experience deploying and optimizing models and perception pipelines on embedded GPUs (e.g., PyTorch, CUDA, TensorRT, NVIDIA Jetson)
- Experience with test-driven development and automated testing of robotics software, including regression testing of robot behavior with logged data, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop testing
- Experience using AI coding assistants and agents to speed up development, with sound judgment about reviewing and verifying their output
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of leading technical work across science and engineering teams

title: Associate Account Executive , SMB
descriptionHtml:
This is not your typical entry-level sales role — it's a launchpad.

At Amazon, our peculiar culture and obsession with delighting customers extends to everything we do, including what we call our teams. While the industry knows this role as a SDR, BDR, Associate Account Executive, Amazon's customer-first DNA means we call our team members "Customer Acquisition Representatives" (CARs). It's more than a name, it reflects our belief that every interaction should start and end with the customer. As a CAR, you'll accelerate pipeline growth, navigate complex customer landscapes, shift gears between strategic thinking and high-impact execution, and put customers in the driver's seat of their cloud journey. Every CAR needs fuel, yours will be curiosity, coaching, and the full support of the world's leading cloud platform.

As a CAR, you will take the lead in unlocking growth potential for both new and existing AWS customers. We are one of the principal sources of new pipeline that fuels the AWS engine – engaging the unengaged accounts and contacts to drive pipeline that turns into revenue. Using cutting-edge AI tools and data-driven insights, you'll identify whitespace opportunities and develop innovative strategies to reach unengaged accounts at scale. You'll be part of shaping how technology is deployed across thousands of organizations, from enabling rapid, individually customized cancer treatments to helping Fortune 500 companies meet their carbon emissions goals. The AWS technology stack is the backbone of some of the most innovative solutions to the world's most pressing problems.

Your career path is clear. This role is designed as the entry point into AWS's North American sales organization. We don't need the perfect candidate, but we do want people who are curious, coachable, and willing to learn. We've developed hundreds of early-career professionals into full cycle sellers as Cloud Sales Representatives (CSRs), many within 18–24 months. You'll be paired with mentors and have access to structured development programs that accelerate your growth from day one.

According to Gartner, AWS is the leading cloud provider in both ability to execute and completeness of vision. With only 5% of all IT spend in the cloud, we are still in the early stages of what is possible, and with the explosion of generative AI, the opportunity has never been larger. You'll be at the forefront, equipped with the most advanced AI-powered sales technology in the industry. Consider this your pit crew advantage — the tools, training, and teammates that keep you performing at your best.


Key job responsibilities
•Partner closely with Account Teams to develop a deep understanding of the primary industries, accounts, and personas within your territories — building relationships from technical admins to Line of Business executives.
•Lead top-of-funnel activity: conduct high-quality account research and source net-new contacts at scale to execute high-volume prospecting, lead qualification, and opportunity generation across your assigned territories.
•Drive net-new business via customer acquisition by leveraging one-to-one and one-to-many outbound campaigns, in addition to qualifying leads from marketing and partner channels.
•Expand services breadth and consumption within your existing customer base via account planning and territory management.
•Deliver results against input and output goals, including: contacts sourced, leads qualified, customer calls completed, meetings scheduled, and opportunities created and launched.
•Leverage AI-powered sales intelligence platforms, predictive analytics, and automation tools to identify high-propensity accounts, prioritize outreach, and optimize pipeline development in Salesforce.
•Stay ahead of the curve with next-generation engagement strategies using generative AI, agentic workflows, and advanced personalization engines — you'll be on the cutting edge of how AI transforms B2B sales, continuously testing and iterating on new approaches to reach unengaged accounts.
•Collaborate with teammates to share best practices, contribute to team learning, and collectively raise the bar for customer engagement.

We know great candidates don't always check every box. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match, we encourage you to apply.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- 2+ year(s) of experience in sales, business development, lead generation, or customer-facing roles (internships and non-traditional experience count)

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of experience in technology sales, SaaS, or cloud services
- Experience with outbound prospecting tools and techniques (cold calling, social selling, email sequencing)

descriptionHtml:
アマゾンジャパンのフルフィルメントネットワークは、アマゾンのカスタマーに毎日多くのパッケージと笑顔をお届けしています。当社は地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業を目指しており、意欲的でカスタマー志向の強いOperations Managerを募集しています。

当社の物流拠点のビジネスゴールを達成するためにチームのオペレーションを管理する責任を負います。あなたのチームは20～300 名程度のメンバーで構成されます。数十億円の予算規模の年間の運営計画を立て、その実行責任を負います。分析スキルや問題解決スキルに加え、チームとしてパフォーマンス目標を確実に達成するため、メンバーと良好な関係を構築し、チームのリーダーシップを強化するためのコーチングやメンタリングなどの人材管理スキルを発揮することやや新しいサービスの導入を進めていく改善スキル、推進力も期待されます。

私たちは毎年新しいオペレーション拠点を立ち上げ、プロフェッショナルとしての成長機会を提供しています。パートタイムのアソシエイトからDirectorまで、多様なBackgroundを持つメンバーとのCross-functionalワークを通じて、新しい視点やスキルを身に付けることができます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。

Key job responsibilities

Operations Managerは、大きな組織をリードしリージョンやネットワークの取り組みを実行する次のSite LeaderまたはSenior Operations Managerへと成長することが期待されます。また、Supply Chain、Transportation、およびLogisticsなどAmazon のオペレーションのあらゆるOpportunityを模索することもできます。

【具体的な業務内容】
- 物流拠点運営、ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
- シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
- 組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
- オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
- 物量等の予測に基づく、戦略的な計画立案、パフォーマンスの評価、問題の解決および人材配置に関するニーズへの対応
- メンバーがより生産的で、パフォーマンスが高く、多様性があり、インクルーシブになるようサポート、指導し、動機付けします。チームメンバーの個人的な成功に対するビジョンとコミットメントを持って、共感を持ってリーダーシップを発揮し、楽しく仕事をし、メンバーに楽しんでもらいましょう。
- Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
- 年間のオペレーション計画を編成し、日次/週次の生産計画と実績確認、短期/長期の需要変動対応、3PLを含む関係者との調整を通じて、コストを管理しながら、年間のオペレーション計画を実行します。
- DEI やSustainability関連の大規模プロジェクトや、Family Day、ボランティアイベントなどの大規模イベントをリードします。
- 部署間、シフト間、およびネットワーク間でベストプラクティスが着実に共有されるように、積極的なアクションを講じます。

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、Amazonの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。
