title: System Development Engineer,, DSP Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in building high-performance, globally scalable systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Does the prospect of working with top engineering talent get you charged up?

Looking for a highly motivated System Development Engineer to help build Amazon's business critical delivery systems and build solutions to operate at scale. You will work on critical business functions for our customers around the world while meeting system availability goals and ensuring system performance with growing business needs. You will discover innovative ways to automate and scale our infrastructure as we expand globally. You will work together with multiple teams and departments, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

The ideal candidate has a passion for understanding computing systems and for applying that understanding with an obsession for delighting customers. In this role, you will apply your skills of system design, networking, coding/scripting languages, as well as technical communication and project organization to make your impact on improving our business processes. The candidate is expected to contribute work critical initiatives, build products, lead engineers to troubleshoot, debug, evaluate and resolve computer-identified alarms, make feature enhancements, systems management, perform software deployments and migrations, host management and automate the operational tasks.

They would also be responsible to develop tools and end to end automation to achieve human free operations.

As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.

Key job responsibilities
Design, implement, maintain, and deploy components that solve problems in a complex ecosystem. We work in lots of different languages (not limited to, but most often Python and Java). It is more important to us that you understand coding in the context of working in distributed systems and/or widely scaled web applications.

● Lead migration projects from planning through execution, including infrastructure setup, data replication, traffic management, and post-migration validation

● Identify and implement cost optimization strategies to reduce per-offering costs through automation and streamlined operations.

● Mentor and guide junior engineers, conducting code reviews, providing technical direction, and fostering a culture of operational excellence within the team.

● Lead root cause analysis for high-severity incidents, implement preventive measures, and drive operational improvements across the team's processes and tooling.

● Collaborate with service teams across Amazon to identify and resolve migration blockers

● Participate in on-call rotations to ensure operational support for critical migration activities

● Building AI-assisted workflows that streamline migration operation or make our day to day job easier and faster.

● Perform deep dive on services with different compute type to generate recommendations for optimization of resources.

A day in the life
You will lead the technical direction for complex migration challenges using AWS technologies and modern development practices. You might collaborate on pipeline infrastructure setups, build AI-assisted workflows that streamline migration operations, or develop tools in Python and Java to automate critical migration tasks. You'll work closely with service teams across Amazon to identify and resolve migration obstacles, analyze memory efficiency across service fleets. Your work will span infrastructure setup, data replication, traffic management, and post-migration validation, all while supporting operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. You'll also mentor team members, participate in design reviews, and collaborate with Seattle-based leadership on strategic priorities.

About the team
We are the Amazon DSP Analytics team, supporting all business pillars across the DSP organization horizontally, with the vision to enable data-, insights-, and science-driven decision-making. We are an exceptionally talented and fun-loving team. Here, you'll have the opportunity to dive deep into complex business and data problems, drive large-scale technical solutions, and raise the bar for operational excellence. We love sharing ideas and learning from each other, and we believe in using those ideas to disrupt the status quo.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- 4+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science
- Experience in Performance tuning or optimization of compute resources.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale
- 4+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)

title: Operations Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
Il team Operations è il cuore pulsante di Amazon ed è grazie al suo operato impeccabile che riusciamo a elaborare e spedire gli ordini ai nostri clienti in tempi record. Nel ruolo di Operations Lead/Supervisor avrai l’opportunità di toccare con mano l’interazione tra le diverse componenti delle nostre attività operative, contribuendo in prima persona a garantirne un funzionamento efficiente.
Sarai il punto di riferimento per i colleghi durante il turno di lavoro e li aiuterai a seguire i processi introdotti dai manager. Il ruolo prevede una forte componente pratica: avrai la possibilità di acquisire esperienza nell’utilizzo di strumenti e sistemi da cui dipende il successo della nostra attività.
Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL Logistica, Trasporti & merci. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

Il lavoro si svolge su turni: mattina, pomeriggio, notte.

Key job responsibilities
- Misurare e monitorare i flussi di lavoro e le performance del sito, nonché fornire rilevanti informazioni ai manager di prima linea per garantire l’eccellenza operativa in tutti i turni.
- Supportare e formare il personale affinché assicuri un servizio d’eccellenza e supervisionarlo nello svolgimento delle mansioni quotidiane.
- Supportare l’Area/Shift Manager nell’ambito di progetti per migliorare i processi, creare un ambiente di lavoro sicuro e aumentare il coinvolgimento del personale.
- Collaborare con altri reparti per individuare soluzioni tese a risolvere problematiche frequenti o soddisfare le necessità, laddove la produttività è cruciale.
- Analizzare i dati per identificare piani volti all’ottimizzazione della sicurezza, qualità e produttività.

A day in the life
Il tuo lavoro di Operations Lead/Supervisor si svolgerà in uno dei nostri siti operativi. Affiancherai l’Area/Shift Manager nell’esecuzione del piano per il turno. Le mansioni di cui ti occuperai spazieranno dall’organizzazione delle riunioni di inizio turno con il team al monitoraggio delle procedure, per assicurare che tutti rispettino le norme di sicurezza, i processi di qualità e le priorità della giornata.
Segnalerai eventuali criticità ai manager, ma talvolta sarai tu la figura più senior durante un turno e spetterà a te fornire le indicazioni per portare a termine ogni incarico. A volte affiancherai l’Area/Shift Manager nella definizione dei turni, in modo da assicurare la presenza di personale a sufficienza anche nei periodi di massima attività.

Basic qualifications

- Conoscenza avanzata dell’italiano, scritto e parlato.
- Vasta esperienza nell’analisi dei dati in un contesto professionale e nell’utilizzo di tali indicatori per l’individuazione di problemi.
- Buona padronanza del pacchetto MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) in contesti di uso professionale.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

descriptionHtml:

The Senior Manager, Liquid Cooling Operations will build and lead a new organization responsible for the health and integrity of cooling fluid flowing through AWS's server fleet. The team is being stood up from scratch, and the person who takes this role will define what the function looks like, hire the core engineers, establish the standards, and own the outcomes across three interconnected disciplines: fluid chemistry and health monitoring, leak detection and physical operations, and system performance analytics.

descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.

Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

title: EU Regulatory Airspace Specialist, Drone Delivery, EU/UK Regulatory Affairs Prime Air
descriptionHtml:
Prime Air is bringing drone delivery to Europe. Every site we open needs safe, approved access to airspace, and today that is the single largest bottleneck between us and launch. You will own it.
You will lead airspace integration for our European operations: the airspace case inside each Operational Authorisation, national procedures, Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) approvals, U-Space coordination, and the relationships with air navigation service providers that make it work. You will also lead our Detect-and-Avoid validation work with national authorities, turning a novel technology into something a regulator can accept. Success is airspace approved on time for every site on our launch plan, and a repeatable method that gets faster with each one.

Key job responsibilities
Own airspace assessment tasks and integration work in the EU: e.g. BVLOS flight authorisation, U-Space coordination, national airspace procedures, geographical zone screening for each candidate site
Deliver the airspace components of EU site approvals, working with the Head of Regulatory Approvals who owns the overall Operational Authorisation.
Own the air risk assessment within each SORA application: e.g. air risk class determination, strategic and tactical mitigations, and the DAA evidence that supports them, delivered to the EU Head of Regulatory Approvals for integration into the safety case.
Lead engagement with Air Navigation Service Providers and U-Space service providers, and manage airspace and ANSP consultants during application peaks.
Keep airspace positions consistent across jurisdictions, working with the wider Regulatory Affairs team.
Build reusable airspace templates and evidence packs so each new site is faster than the last.

A day in the life
You will split your time between authority and ANSP engagement, building the airspace case for the next site, and working with our engineering and safety teams to turn technical capability into regulatory evidence. You will travel to candidate sites and authority meetings across the EU.

About the team
How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers and are excited for what's to come.
If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Amazon is the place for you.
Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos).

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related technical field
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
- Aviation airspace or air traffic management background, with UAS or U-Space integration experience in an EU Member State.
- Working knowledge of the EU U-Space regulation (2021/664) and national airspace procedures in one or more Member States.
- Familiarity with Detect-and-Avoid concepts, the Specific Operations Risk Assessment (SORA) methodology and airspace risk assessment.
- Proven stakeholder engagement with EU National Aviation Authorities and Air Navigation Service Providers.

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience applying SORA end to end, including SAIL determination, Operational Safety Objectives and ground and air risk mitigation.
- Experience engaging multiple national aviation authorities simultaneously.
- Experience securing airspace access or drone corridor approvals with an ANSP.

Every insight surfaced to security leadership, from builder productivity trends to security issue quality metrics, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains.

Our engineers work directly with source systems across AWS and SDO (Security, Developer, and Operations) data domains to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.

Maintain understanding of relevant data lineage: sources of data, how metrics are aggregated, and how BI is consumed and acted upon by security leadership. Learn the business context behind the team's data infrastructure and metrics definitions. Investigate data anomalies and validate outputs against source data and business logic.

Build small to mid-size BI solutions, or components of larger solutions, to answer straightforward business questions with data. Be proficient in SQL, maintain straightforward ETL, and create data structures using schema definition languages. Use analytics and visualization tools (e.g., QuickSight, Excel, Tableau) to deliver actionable insights.

Take well-defined requirements and deliver on schedule. Seek input and guidance from team members on technology and business context. Participate in team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions. Communicate findings effectively to a technical audience.

Work effectively with customers (e.g., business teams, Data Scientists) and internal partners to ensure deliverables meet expectations. Partner with peer BIEs and others on the team. Help train new peers. Participate in the interview process.

title: SDM Verification & Monitoring, AWS Governance
descriptionHtml:
AWS CloudTrail records API and user activity across hundreds of AWS services, giving customers complete visibility into their cloud operations for security and compliance. As AI agents increasingly make decisions and invoke APIs at scale, the need to verify that every event is generated correctly, completely, and on time has never been more urgent. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead the verification and monitoring team within AWS CloudTrail. You will own the platform that detects data loss, integrity issues, and coverage gaps before customers are impacted — across all delivery channels and 378+ integrated services. You will combine technical depth with people leadership to grow engineers, shape architecture, and drive end-to-end outcomes that give AWS service teams confidence to move fast without compromising event quality.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical roadmap for the verification and monitoring platform, defining strategy that ensures every event is delivered correctly and completely across all integrated AWS services.
- Lead and grow a team of engineers and technical leaders by recruiting top talent, providing coaching and actionable feedback, and building programs to develop and retain high performers.
- Establish AI-assisted development workflows — including AI-powered code generation, automated code reviews, and intelligent test creation — to multiply your team's engineering output while maintaining quality.
- Drive cross-team engagement with AWS service teams and internal stakeholders using agile practices and strong program management to align priorities, manage dependencies, and report findings that shape organizational decisions.
- Build and maintain automated monitoring systems that proactively detect data loss, integrity failures, and coverage gaps, ensuring issues are caught and remediated before they reach customers.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing verification dashboards and monitoring alerts to understand event integrity across AWS services. You join a design review where your engineers propose a new detection capability, and you pressure-test assumptions to sharpen the approach. After a one-on-one where you help a technical leader plan their next career milestone, you shift to a cross-team sync with an AWS service team to align on an upcoming launch and its event coverage requirements. Later, you review your team's prioritized project list, adjust sequencing based on new findings, and close the day by drafting a status update for leadership on recent impact metrics.

About the team
The Governance verification and monitoring team is the independent quality layer that ensures the accuracy and completeness of every audit event generated across AWS. Our work directly protects customers who depend on CloudTrail for security, compliance, and operational visibility. We are an inclusive group of engineers and leaders who value clear thinking, technical rigor, and a genuine commitment to each other's growth. As AWS accelerates AI adoption across its services, our mission is growing — we are investing in GenAI-powered monitoring, consolidating our platform architecture, and expanding coverage to keep pace with new services and agentic workloads.

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Installation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Relocation assistance will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
• Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
• Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
• Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
• Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
• Safely using material handling tools and equipment
• Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

Physical Requirements:
• All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of data center, critical environment, computer hardware repair, infrastructure cabling, network deployment, or data center operations experience, or experience in similar technical roles
- 2+ years of network cabling, fiber optics, and test equipment including VFL, power meter, and OTDR experience
- Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Network Engineering), or experience in professional or military IT-related roles
- certification in a relevant field (CCENT - Cisco Certified Entry Networking Technician, Network+, or CCNA - Cisco Certified Network Associate)
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- Experience conducting behavioral interviews and hiring

title: Senior Seller Consultant, CN2MX
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a smart and ambitious Seller Consultant to join its China team. The objective of the Sales consultant is to deliver new business growth and maximize revenue generation across Amazon's suite of products for merchants. Recruiting and launching sellers on Amazon's global marketplaces. You will analyze traffic and sales data to identify opportunities to help sellers succeed on the marketplaces.

Your superior communication, organizational and technical skills will enable you to operate in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, where you will have the autonomy to take full control and responsibility for achieving our business objectives.
Specific Responsibilities include:
- Develop a category recruitment strategy by analyzing the competitive landscape and defining new products' value proposition.
- Identify, recruit and support sellers of various types (SMEs to large brand owners) to execute on growth plans.
- Review and monitor performance and sales of Amazon's partners in order to provide them with consulting advice to grow their business.
- Feed back to other teams within Amazon worldwide lessons learned during project implementation and post-live support phases.

Develop and execute strategies to identify, attract, and onboard high-quality CN sellers to the Amazon Mexico.

Build a robust pipeline of prospective sellers through outreach, networking, and partnership initiatives.

Provide dedicated, hands-on support to new sellers during their critical launch phase to ensure a successful "cold start" on the platform.

Guide sellers through account setup, catalog creation, and the implementation of best practices for listing, pricing, and fulfillment.

Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with a portfolio of Chinese sellers.

Act as the primary point of contact and advocate for sellers, ensuring a positive experience with Amazon Mexico.

title: Specialist Solutions Architect Databases, AGS-EMEA-Europe North
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping customers build database and cloud solutions? Come join us !

At Amazon, we've been investing deeply in building the right solutions that allow you to derive the most value from your database infrastructure. AWS is looking for a specialist solutions architect for our Database team, who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) helping customers to design complex solutions. As part of the team, you will work closely with Europe North customers across all industry verticals to enable large-scale use cases and drive the adoption of advanced AWS services. You will interact with other Solution Architects in the field, providing guidance on their customer engagements, and you will develop white papers, blogs, reference implementations, and presentations to enable customers to fully leverage AWS.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and trustworthy support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.



Key job responsibilities

• Working closely with our product and field teams and 3rd party model providers, you will help enable new capabilities for our customers to develop and deploy data workloads on AWS infrastructure
• Design best in class database infrastructure solutions for all stages of customer and product lifecycles.
• You will have the technical depth and business experience to deploy database and data strategies.
• Partner with SAs, Sales, Business Development and Service teams to accelerate customer adoption and revenue attainment.

title: Data Quality Specialist - Turkish, AGI Data Services - G T Quality
descriptionHtml:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.

About the team
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Turkish
- Intermediate-level proficiency in English (B2+ or equivalent fluency by CEFR standards)
- 1+ years of experience in a quality assurance, quality control, or data quality role
- Experience defining, tracking, and reporting quality metrics or KPIs

title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Food Safety Manager is a role within the Food Safety & Quality organization, focusing primarily on WWGS Private Brands. This position is responsible for ensuring the safety, compliance, and continuous improvement of all food production sites that supply our private brand portfolio. The manager will lead a team focused on facility approvals, conduct rigorous due diligence and facility reviews, and manage corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs). The role requires deep collaboration with cross-functional teams and proficiency in multiple digital platforms, including Foodlogiq, CMX1, and internal Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools. Candidate must have a proven track record leading Food Safety Professionals, utilizing soft skills, effective decision making, and metrics to drive improvements across an organization.

• Cross-functional networking across stakeholder business units to champion food safety
• Ability to present metrics rich data to teams and persuade an audience to support proposals.
2. Facility Approval & Due Diligence
• New Facility Qualification: Perform the end-to-end qualification of new food production sites for WWGS Private Brands, ensuring all regulatory, hygiene, and safety standards are met before any product is released.
• Ongoing Due Diligence: Maintain and update due diligence documentation for all existing production sites, including audits, certifications, and compliance evidence.
• Risk Assessment: Perform periodic risk assessments to identify potential hazards and develop mitigation strategies.
• Onboarding Process: Optimize and implement an efficient supplier onboarding workflow that integrates food safety criteria, facility qualification, and system data entry.

• Supplier Scorecarding: Maintain a supplier scorecard system that captures performance metrics (e.g., audit results, CAPA closure rates, compliance status) and feeds into supplier selection and renewal decisions.
4. Systems & Tool Proficiency
• Platform Management: Become an expert user of Foodlogiq, CMX1, and internal Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools. Ensure all food safety data is accurately entered, maintained, and reported through these systems.
• Process Optimization: Advise on how to leverage these tools to streamline supplier onboarding, improve visibility into supplier performance, and automate routine due diligence tasks.
• Data-Driven Decision Making: Pull and analyze data from the platforms to generate insights, dashboards, and trend reports that support strategic decision-making.
5. Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA)
• Incident Management: Work closely with the Incident Management team to investigate and close out CAPAs resulting from food safety incidents, non-conformances, or audit findings.
• Root Cause Analysis: Lead root cause investigations, develop effective corrective actions, and verify effectiveness of preventive actions.
• CAPA Tracking: Maintain a centralized CAPA log within the appropriate system, ensuring timely closure and documentation of all actions.
6. Policy, Procedure & Compliance
• Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Develop, maintain, and enforce SOPs related to facility qualification, audit planning, and CAPA management.
• Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all activities comply with FDA, FSMA, USDA, and other applicable food safety regulations.
• Continuous Improvement: Champion a culture of continuous improvement through regular reviews of processes, metrics, and system capabilities.
7. Reporting & Communication
• Executive Reporting: Provide regular updates to senior leadership on key metrics (e.g., audit results, CAPA closure rates, supplier performance) through dashboards and written reports.
• Cross-Functional Updates: Deliver clear, data driven presentations to cross-functional teams to communicate risk status, audit findings, and improvement initiatives.

- Yield Improvement & Data Analytics: Lead yield attack initiatives analyzing first pass and final pass failures. Conduct DOEs to root-cause defects, feeding findings back into the TCD to continuously refine test coverage and limits.
- Design Feedback & CM Partnership: Drive DFM/DFA feedback to hardware and firmware teams with testability requirements captured in the TCD from early design phases. Lead cross-functional coordination across engineering, business development, operations, and the CM.

Every day brings new challenges to Leo. In the morning, you may be working on the technology roadmap for the next five years and in the afternoon diving deep on a technical issue delaying a build. title: DataCenter Technician , Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a skilled Data Center Technician with a passion for technology to help us expand our cloud to the next level. You may be the primary point of contact for both internal teams (such as Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, and Software Developers) and external partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, and Service Providers). You'll be working in large-scale, high-density data centers where you'll help change the face of cloud technology in the region.

At AWS, career progression is part of our culture. Whether your path leads to Systems, Network, or Database Engineering, Software Development, AWS Support, Technical Operations, or Project Management, we'll work with you to create a development plan that helps you reach your goals — starting from Day One.

Please apply with your updated CV in English.


Key job responsibilities
Problem Solving
• Maintain high system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently
• Serve as an escalation point and technical troubleshooter for systems and network hardware issues
• Investigate and resolve complex Linux server issues
• Troubleshoot virtualization service problems

Technical
• Troubleshoot technical issues across systems, networking, and power/mechanical domains
• Remediate physical layer outages in systems and networks, including power-related problems
• Participate in data center power and cooling events

Operations
• Work rotating shifts to meet 24/7 on-call requirements
• Install and configure server racks per internal SLAs
• Triage and resolve trouble tickets for all devices in the assigned region
• Act as the data center point of contact for high-severity issues
• Replace server and network device components as needed
• Ensure correct rotation of spare parts
• Contribute to uptime improvement metrics
• Enforce Amazon's security best practices
• Collaborate with third-party vendors, contractors, and remote support teams

Project Management
• Participate in and deliver high-impact small to mid-scale projects
• Attend team meetings for metric analysis and project status updates
• Contribute to building the world's largest cloud infrastructure

Mentoring
• Share knowledge and support team members in developing their technical skills and best practices


A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician, no two days are the same. You might start your morning reviewing support tickets and prioritizing the day's interventions. From there, you could be installing new servers in racks, diagnosing a network issue, or performing preventive maintenance on critical equipment.

You'll work at the heart of our infrastructure, collaborating with cross-functional teams — network engineers, operations managers, and vendors. Each day brings new technical challenges that allow you to grow your skills and have a direct impact on the reliability of AWS services used by millions of customers worldwide.

You'll also have the opportunity to mentor colleagues, contribute to continuous improvement projects, and help shape the evolution of our practices and team. AWS provides assistive lifting equipment to support the physical aspects of the role, ensuring a safe and comfortable working environment for everyone.


About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating. That's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Server hardware troubleshooting experience, including server booting processes (POST, BIOS, PXE, Kickstart, GRUB/LILO, RAID)
- Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, Ethernet) and network hardware (copper/fiber cabling, switches, routers)
- Linux administration knowledge
- Good level of English

Preferred qualifications

- Strong understanding of Linux/Unix administration
- Experience with remote access tools (console routers, IPMI, BMC)
- Network equipment installation and configuration experience
- Understanding of redundancy concepts (power feeds, ATS, server hardware, RAID, network connectivity)
- Project management experience
- Scripting experience (Bash, Python, Perl, Ruby, or similar programming languages)

title: Senior Solutions Architect, EMEA Partner Solutions Architecture
descriptionHtml:
The largest enterprise transformation deals are won or lost through Global System Integrators (GSIs). The top-tier GSIs own the transformational relationship, but they need AWS technical leadership to shape, de-risk, and close multi-workload deals. These deals run for 18–36 months, and a single deal can be worth more than an entire portfolio of smaller opportunities.

AWS is hiring a Senior Partner Solutions Architect to lead technical strategy on these pursuits. This isn't an advisory role. You'll own the technical architecture and deal strategy. You'll work alongside the GSI's deal teams from the moment an opportunity is identified until it's ready for delivery. Your success is measured in the annual run rate (ARR) of the deals won.

Location: UK/NL/DE/ES

What you'll do in this role:

Lead large, complex pursuits. You'll own the technical strategy for multi-workload, multi-account, often multi-region deals worth $10M+ ARR, and you'll make the final call on architecture.

Engage early and shape the deal. You'll run deal clinics with GSI partners to build and qualify pipeline, shaping the technical approach and the commercial framing that follows from it.

Bring architectural rigour. You'll enforce Well-Architected design, size workloads, de-risk the technical path, and build the business case (TCO, ROI) that gives customers the confidence to commit.

Orchestrate the ecosystem. You'll align GSI deal teams, AWS account teams, specialists, and service teams around one executable plan.

Support the deal mechanics. As the architecture takes shape, you'll help translate it into the practical terms a deal needs. This includes teaming, milestones, funding, and consumption while working alongside the partner so the technical plan and the agreement stay aligned.

Hand off cleanly, then move on. You'll align the consumption model to the partner's Statement of Work milestones. You'll also hand delivery context over to the alliance and account teams, then move on to the next high-value pursuit.

Build mechanisms that scale. You'll turn what you learn into playbooks and deal clinic frameworks, including reusable patterns for structuring these engagements so alliance teams can run these deals on their own.

You'll work closely with Partner Development Managers, alliance PSAs, account managers, Account SAs, and Customer Success Managers. You'll also influence senior stakeholders at the GSI, the customer, and AWS.

The role requires roughly 25% travel to meet partners and customers.


Key job responsibilities
Lead technical engagement and own the architecture on GSI-led opportunities of $10M+ ARR, from identification through to delivery readiness.

Turn customer transformation roadmaps into clear, costed AWS solutions, and explain technical choices in terms of business outcomes.

Work through the GSI partner and respect its ownership of the customer relationship.

Design enterprise-scale architectures, landing zones, multi-account structures, and migration strategies, and run Well-Architected reviews.

Build proofs of concept, reference architectures, and implementation guides, and review and approve architectures that the GSI develops.

Develop business cases, TCO analyses, risk assessments, and mitigation plans that move deals to commitment.

Ensure the technical solution translates into the partner's commercial model.

Work with alliance PSAs to build GSI capability through certifications, reusable architecture patterns, and independent solution delivery.

Support deals through to revenue realisation with architecture reviews, specialist support, and get-to-green plans when delivery goes off track.

Share customer and partner feedback with AWS product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap.

Adapt solutions to industry-specific regulatory and compliance requirements across multiple industries.

Basic qualifications

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures

title: Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon builds fast—and behind every new Fulfillment Center, Sortation Center, Delivery Station, and capital investment is a critical question: **Are we buying the right solution at the right price?** We're looking for a **Cost & Value Engineering Manager** to partner with Amazon's North America Design & Construction stakeholders, delivering construction cost engineering and value engineering services that optimize design, validate costs, and inform capital investment decisions across Amazon's infrastructure network.

This role is high-impact, high-variety, and technically demanding. You'll develop bottom-up cost estimates, should-cost models, and Value Engineering analyses across a diverse portfolio of building types, material handling equipment (MHE), automation, and capital projects. From multi-site retrofit programs to complex, one-off initiatives, you'll evaluate design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and produce defensible cost models that shape sourcing, design, and investment decisions. Working from early concepts through bid-ready construction documents, you'll apply technical expertise to balance cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements.

As part of Amazon's Global Procurement Organization within the Sourcing Excellence pillar, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Construction, Procurement, and Category teams to ensure Amazon is buying the right solution at the right price. You'll also collaborate with AI and Market Intelligence Solutions, leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, develop scalable cost intelligence, and advance next-generation automation that expands the reach and impact of Cost & Value Engineering across Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
Deliver independent, bottom-up cost estimates for construction, equipment, and capital investment projects across Amazon's global portfolio, spanning retrofit, expansion, new-build, automation, and equipment deployment initiatives.
Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through supplier selection and implementation, adapting methodologies and analytical depth to available project information and design maturity.
Build and maintain scalable estimating models and templates while developing detailed bottom-up cost models for complex, site-specific initiatives requiring advanced analytical judgment.
Perform should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to evaluate design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and ensure Amazon is buying the right solution at the right price.
Leverage AI-powered tools to automate data gathering, cost modeling, benchmarking, and pattern recognition while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.
Drive the development of scalable AI-enabled cost intelligence solutions by curating project and market data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine analytical activities.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Construction, Procurement, Category Management, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence sourcing and investment decisions.
Peer review cost models, estimates, and Value Engineering recommendations to ensure technical rigor, consistency, and alignment with current market conditions and best practices.

About the team
The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right construction solutions, equipment, and technologies by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what construction projects, equipment, and services should cost.

Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across construction, material handling equipment, automation, and other strategic sourcing categories, and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- Experience in cost engineering, value engineering, commercial development, construction, capital projects, equipment, automation, or related technical disciplines, including roles such as Cost Engineer, Value Engineer, Engineer, Architect, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Equipment Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Owner’s Project Management Representative, Cost Consultant, or other related technical cost and value management roles.

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

title: Software Development Engineer, ElastiCache
descriptionHtml:
This is an opportunity to join one of AWS's most foundational and high-impact engineering teams — the Data Plane team within Amazon ElastiCache and
MemoryDB. We own the core in-memory engine that powers millions of customer workloads: the data path, durability layer, replication protocol, snapshot
system, and advanced data structures. Our work sits at the intersection of systems programming, database internals, and performance engineering — every microsecond matters when you're serving the world's most latency-sensitive applications.

If you've ever found yourself deep in a conversation about write-ahead logs, copy-on-write fork semantics, lock-free data structures, or memory allocator design — and you want to apply those ideas to a system handling millions of operations per second at cloud scale — this team is where you belong. We build the engine behind Amazon MemoryDB, the only Valkey-compatible database that delivers in-memory speed with Multi-AZ durability. We're not just running an open-source cache; we're extending Valkey with novel capabilities — durable replication, active-active conflict resolution, full-text and vector search — while maintaining the sub-millisecond latencies our customers depend on.

Our customers include Disney+, Snap, Zoom, Lyft, Airbnb, and hundreds of thousands of other AWS customers who trust us with their most performance-critical workloads. You'll work in C/C++ at the lowest levels of the stack, solving problems in memory management, I/O optimization, replication protocols, and distributed data systems — all in production at massive scale.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer on the Data Plane team, you will take on broad ownership of the core engine that sits at the heart of ElastiCache and
MemoryDB. Your core responsibilities will include:

- Designing and building the next-generation in-memory database engine, delivering sub-millisecond latencies and millions of operations per second to the world's most demanding applications.
- Developing large-scale distributed in-memory storage systems in C/C++, extending open-source Valkey with durability, replication, and advanced data structure capabilities.
- Building and optimizing the durability layer — transaction logging, snapshotting, and replication protocols — that enables MemoryDB to deliver in-memory speed with Multi-AZ data protection.
- Designing and implementing advanced data structures and query capabilities including vector search and full-text search to support emerging workloads like generative AI.
- Driving performance engineering at the systems level — memory allocator tuning, I/O path optimization, and lock-free concurrency — to push throughput and latency boundaries.
- Contributing to active-active replication and conflict resolution mechanisms that enable globally distributed, low-latency data access.
- Mentoring and growing engineers on the team, serving as a technical leader and role model for engineering best practices.
Managing individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables with a high degree of autonomy and accountability.


A day in the life
Day-to-day, you can expect a dynamic mix of deep technical work and collaborative engineering. A typical week might look like:
- Writing and reviewing production-quality C/C++ code for the core in-memory engine — optimizing data structures, replication paths, and the durability layer for maximum throughput at minimal latency.
- Participating in design reviews and architecture discussions, where you'll debate trade-offs around durability guarantees, memory efficiency, and replication consistency — and then go build the solution.
- Collaborating with peer engineers to debug complex systems issues at the engine level - analyzing crash dumps, tracing memory corruption, and profiling hot paths under production-scale load.
- Working with upstream open-source Valkey contributors and internal partner teams to integrate new capabilities and ensure our extensions remain compatible and performant.
- Engaging with product teams to understand emerging customer needs — from generative AI workloads requiring vector search to globally distributed applications needing active-active replication — and translating those into engine capabilities.
- Mentoring engineers through code reviews, design feedback, and pairing sessions, helping them grow their systems programming skills and engineering judgment.
- Contributing to the team's operational excellence by participating in on-call rotations and driving improvements to engine reliability and diagnostic tooling.

About the team
The Data Plane team is a passionate group of engineers who thrive on solving hard problems at the intersection of database internals and distributed systems. We are a collaborative, intellectually curious team that values technical depth, ownership, and a bias for action. We own the core engine behind Amazon ElastiCache and MemoryDB — the in-memory data path, durability layer, replication protocol, and advanced query capabilities that hundreds of thousands of AWS customers depend on for their most latency-sensitive workloads.

Our customers include some of the world's fastest-growing startups and largest enterprises, all relying on our engine to deliver sub-millisecond performance at scale. We are deeply invested in open-source software and actively contribute to the Valkey community. As a team, we believe in growing together — senior engineers are directly involved in mentoring and developing engineers at all levels, and we take pride in building a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

title: Sr. Applied Scientist, AWS Specialists and Partner Prototyping
descriptionHtml:
Core to Amazon's DNA is its methodology around executing experiments and prototypes to find the quickest way to prove new ideas, technologies, and business models in a real-world environment. Experimentation fuels Amazon's innovation.

Our team does horizon exploration. We take emerging technology, including our own inventions, build working prototypes with customers and partners, and demonstrate what becomes possible before the rest of the market gets there. Prototyping is how we do the work. Pushing the technology horizon is why we do it.

If you are a highly creative problem solver who works to inspire, motivate, and define innovative solutions; are passionate about technology, understand cloud architectures and platforms, and are quick to pick up emerging technologies; are adept at working with customers to experiment with innovative approaches and validate the technical feasibility of solutions, this could be the role for you.

As a Senior Applied Scientist you sit directly with customers and partners. You help them envision complex uses of AWS by building working prototypes of specific use cases, tailored to their data, devices, and systems. Engagements run in short build cycles, typically four to six weeks, and are designed to be innovative and evaluative, demonstrating the art of the possible on AWS while proving a credible path to production.

You will work across the areas where we are placing our biggest bets. These shift as the technology does, but today they include:
- Physical AI and autonomous robotics. World models, vision-language-action (VLA) models, cloud-based and agentic VLA, real-to-sim and sim-to-real pipelines, and agentic control of physical systems. We challenge the assumption that these models have to live only at the edge.
- Autonomous scientific discovery. Self-driving labs and instrument intelligence, where agents plan, run, and interpret experiments across fleets of scientific instruments.
- Agentic developer intelligence. Multi-agent systems, code agents, and automated research workflows that change how software gets built.
- Scaling what we learn. Turning one-off prototypes into reusable patterns and assets the broader field can pick up and run with.

You will not just apply these techniques. You will help decide which bets are worth making and prove or disprove them in the open with real customer problems.

Key job responsibilities
- As a key member of the AWS Specialists and Partner Prototyping team, ensure customer success through hands-on participation producing and demonstrating prototypes on the AWS platform.

- Participate in deep architectural and scientific design discussions to ensure prototypes are crafted for successful deployment in the cloud and a credible path to production.

- Bring applied science depth to engagements: frame the problem, select and adapt models, design experiments, and judge technical feasibility honestly, including when the answer is that an approach will not work.

- Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to prototyping customers, partners, and internal business partners.

- Act as a thought leader for your area of domain expertise across AWS, and share best-practice knowledge among the community.

- Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as peer reviewed position papers, blogs, and reference patterns.

- Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams, and sales, carrying real-world signal back to the teams building the services.

A day in the life
No two engagements look the same, which is the point. A typical week might include:

- Running a working session with a customer's scientists and engineers to pressure-test an idea and agree on what a prototype needs to prove.

- Writing code and training or fine-tuning models in the lab, often against the customer's own data, devices, or robots.

- Pairing with a prototyping SA and engagement manager, the standard pod you deliver alongside, to keep the build moving and the scope honest.

- Demonstrating a working prototype live and walking stakeholders through what it does, what it does not yet do, and what production would take.

- Capturing what you learned as a reusable pattern or publication so the next team does not start from zero.

- Spending time on the horizon itself: reading, experimenting with a new model or technique, and forming a point of view on where a bet is heading.


You will move between hands-on building and customer-facing explanation constantly. The best people in this role are equally comfortable in a research paper, a code editor, and a room full of executives.
