私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、エリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実にお届けされるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
■業務内容■
「エリアマネージャー」には、他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、「People First」の考え方で、各種プロジェクトをリードし、またピープルマネージメントを行っていただきます。また、「エリアマネージャー」は拠点の全ての工程を担当し、上司の示す部署全体の方針や安全・品質・生産性の年間目標に沿って、担当工程における改善を積み重ね、日々の計画、進捗、実績管理に責任をもち活動いただきます。

具体的な業務は以下の通りです。

主な責任と職務内容：
① チームメンバーの育成とサポート
現場の最前線にいるマネージャーとしてチームメンバーと積極的に関わり、メンバーからの意見に基づく職場改善によりエンゲージメントを高めます。また、数名から数十名のチームのマネージャーとして、業務上の知識・スキル、アマゾンカルチャー等の指導を行うことはもちろん、部下の悩みに傾聴し、問題の解決に向けて自ら動きます。さらに、部下の勤怠や労働時間等の把握、管理を適切に行います。

② 担当プロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上
マネージャーはそれぞれ特定のプロセスを担当し、そのプロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上をリードします。日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、作業環境の改善、トレーニングの進捗管理など多岐にわたる改善活動が該当します。問題を特定し、対策を立案し、チームメンバーを巻き込みながら実行に移し、結果を出していくことが求められます。

③ 日々のオペレーション対応
物流拠点のすべての工程を管理し、商品の管理からお客様へお届けするまでの一連の流れの中で計画を立案し管理していただきます。日々のオペレーションにおいてお客様にお約束した納期を確実に守るため、物量の上振れや下振れ、急な労働力不足、システムトラブル等の変動要素に際し、適切に判断して対応していくことが求められます。

④ プロジェクトリーダーとして改善を推進
Amazonでは日々改善が推進されています。エリアマネージャーは通常業務と並行して、安全上のリスクや生産性を改善するプロジェクトのリーダーとして拠点内の年次/月次プロジェクト活動を推進します。これらのプロジェクトにおいては関連部署との協業等も含まれます。

title: Technik BHP
descriptionHtml:
Bezpieczeństwo i dobrostan naszych pracowników to najwyższy priorytet w Amazon. Nasi Technicy BHP odgrywają kluczową rolę w jego zapewnianiu. To stanowisko jest szansą na rozpoczęcie kariery w dziedzinie bezpieczeństwa pracy i rozwój w międzynarodowej firmie. Będziesz ściśle współpracować z naszymi ekspertami, monitorując swój obiekt, dzięki czemu każdego dnia zobaczysz, jaką różnicę robisz dla dobrostanu ludzi.

Key job responsibilities
- Przeprowadzanie ocen ryzyka i audytów.
- Monitorowanie obiektu w celu zapewnienia zgodności procesów z procedurami bezpieczeństwa Amazon.
- Tworzenie i aktualizacja raportów dotyczących wskaźników bezpieczeństwa do przeglądu przez współpracowników.
- Współpraca z kolegami z działu Operations i całej firmy przy zadaniach związanych z bezpieczeństwem oraz doradztwo w zakresie procesów.
- Wsparcie we wdrażaniu nowych środków bezpieczeństwa.

A day in the life
Będziesz pracować w jednym z naszych obiektów. Oznacza to, że będziesz mógł/mogła ściśle śledzić to, co się dzieje, a pracownicy będą mogli łatwo zadawać Ci pytania podczas swoich zmian. Ta rola polega na identyfikowaniu potencjalnych problemów, zanim się pojawią. Będziesz poświęcać dużo czasu na sprawdzanie obiektu i poznawanie sposobu, w jaki ludzie korzystają ze sprzętu. Rozumiejąc, jak działa każde zadanie i każda maszyna, będziesz w stanie znaleźć najlepszy sposób na zapewnienie bezpieczeństwa procesów. Będziesz również jedną z osób wdrażających zmiany w zakresie bezpieczeństwa, co oznacza, że będziesz ściśle współpracować z wieloma osobami. Oprócz codziennych i tygodniowych zadań będziesz wspierać zespół Operations w doraźnych pracach związanych z bezpieczeństwem. Bezpieczeństwo jest niezwykle ważne w Amazon, a Ty pomożesz nam gromadzić kluczowe dane, które pozwalają nam kontrolować nasze procesy i wyprzedzać wszelkie problemy. Będziesz również dzielić się tymi danymi z pracownikami w całej firmie i współpracować z innymi zespołami, aby zapewnić, że bezpieczeństwo jest zawsze na pierwszym miejscu.

About the team
Zespół Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) odgrywa kluczową rolę w zapewnieniu dobrostanu psychicznego i fizycznego naszych pracowników. Nasz zespół współpracuje z kierownikami, pracownikami i lokalnymi władzami we wszystkich naszych obiektach, dbając o zgodność z politykami Amazon i przepisami prawnymi oraz zapewniając bezpieczeństwo naszych środowisk pracy. Zespół oferuje różnorodne możliwości — od Techników BHP po Kierowników Programów. Niezależnie od Twojego stanowiska, będziesz przyczyniać się do rozwoju i wdrażania strategii bezpieczeństwa w całej sieci.

Basic qualifications

- Wykształcenie Technik BHP lub wyższe z zakresu BHP (zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Rady Ministrów Dz.U.1997.109.704).
- Odpowiednie doświadczenie w wykorzystywaniu analizy danych do generowania i objaśniania wskaźników.
- Znajomość polskiej legislacji w zakresie BHP.
- Biegła znajomość języka polskiego i podstawowa znajomość angielskiego (A2), w mowie i piśmie.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferowane kwalifikacje nie są wymagane do aplikowania na stanowisko w Amazon. Jeśli posiadasz wszystkie powyższe kwalifikacje podstawowe, chętnie poznamy Twoją kandydaturę.
- Doświadczenie z metodologiami Lean, 5S lub Kaizen.
- Doświadczenie w planowaniu lub zarządzaniu inicjatywami proekologicznymi.
- Umiejętność pracy samodzielnej oraz w zespole.

title: Senior ProServe Cloud Architect, Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
As customer demand for AI accelerates, the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services Strategic Accounts team is adding dedicated AI expertise to help our most ambitious customers design and implement agentic business and technology solutions. We are looking for a ProServe Cloud Architect who can be the technical bridge between ProServe Account Executives and Shared Delivery Teams, leading solution design from presales through delivery to ensure every proposal is realistic, achievable, and directly tied to customer business outcomes. You will translate complex technical concepts into business value, helping customers adopt cloud and AI capabilities that move them from experimentation to production. If you are a curious, adaptable technologist with consulting experience who enjoys turning customer challenges into well-architected solutions, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
* Lead solution design for customer engagements, working with ProServe Account Executives to scope proposals that align technical approaches with measurable customer business outcomes.
* Architect cloud and AI solutions — including agentic AI architectures — across system design, data warehousing, DevOps, and generative AI, ensuring designs are secure, scalable, and cost-effective.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders, translating technical recommendations into business language and guiding customers through their cloud and AI adoption journey.
* Drive presales activities by assessing customer maturity, defining technical strategies, and contributing to go-to-market approaches that identify and close new opportunities.
* Create reusable artifacts, reference architectures, and best practices that improve delivery efficiency, while mentoring team members and sharing knowledge across the organization.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin with a presales call, working alongside a ProServe Account Executive to understand a customer's business objectives and sketch out a proposed solution architecture. Later, you could be deep in a design review with a Shared Delivery Team, pressure-testing an agentic AI solution before presenting it to customer leadership. Between engagements, you refine reusable frameworks and mentor colleagues, making sure lessons from one customer can benefit the next.

About the team
The Strategic Accounts team within AWS Professional Services works with some of AWS's most forward-thinking customers. The team is investing in AI expertise to accelerate customers' journeys from early AI exploration to production-grade agentic solutions. Made up of ProServe Account Executives and ProServe Cloud Architects, the team partners closely with the AWS Partner Network and Shared Delivery Teams to execute enterprise cloud initiatives. We are building an inclusive culture grounded in collaboration and continuous learning.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
- 5+ years of database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis) experience
- 7+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
- 3+ years of cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system experience
- 7+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
- Bachelor's degree, or 7+ years of professional or military experience

Preferred qualifications

- degree in advanced technology, or AWS Professional level certification
- Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
- Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR
- Experience in performance optimization and cost management for cloud environments
- Experience communicating technical concepts to diverse audiences in pre-sales environments

title: SR Risk Specialist, Social Responsibility - Human Rights, Sustainability, GPO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s mission is to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need to develop leaders who represent, and can innovate, on behalf of a diverse and demanding global customer base. The Global Procurement Organization (GPO) identifies and procures goods and services at the best value for business, maintaining the quality of products and ensuring that alternative sources of supply are available. The Social Responsibility (SR) and Human Rights program drives customer trust and business continuity by ensuring respect for the rights of workers throughout Amazon’s supply chain and operations. We uphold company standards and expectations (such as Amazon's Supply Chain Standards and Human Rights Principles), and seek to constantly improve the tools and processes that we use in doing so.
As a SR Risk Specialist in SR Ops, within the Global Procurement Sustainability (GPS) team, you will work closely with Amazon’s Social Responsibility team and the Global Procurement Organization to implement mechanisms to meet Amazon’s human rights principles and Supply Chain Standards and to ensure our suppliers are compliant with those.
You will be responsible for Audit risk assessment activities across Global Operations suppliers and remediation plan coordination. You will work closely with internal and external partners to plan and execute high-quality and impactful audits, which address the highest human right risks.
You will insist on the highest standards for your audits and you will be able to dive deep into every audit area, apply broad technical knowledge, sound business judgment, and partner with key stakeholders.


Key job responsibilities
• Work across GPO, collaborating with external partners (Audit companies) and internal business partners, such as Operations, WW SR and Sustainability, Legal and Risk Management to identify and assess regulatory and human rights compliance risks as it relates to our supplier baseline
• Review new and existing suppliers (legacy) ensuring that they meet Human Rights compliance, safety, terms of service standards, investigate suspicious suppliers / driver activity and behaviors that could pose a risk to Amazon, our customers, or others
• Be responsible for site-level/ supplier remediation of high-severity issues identified in assessments, or external sources (i.e., whistle-blower, media alerts, worker voice)
• Assist with creation of investigation plans to determine root cause, and leads the remediation efforts with CSR while maintaining communication with leadership and impacted stakeholders
• Coordinate and plan remediation activities for suppliers in case of high-risk findings
• Handle day-to-day issues (constantly thinking about how to invent and simplify to improve)

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 2+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience with data analysis (including advanced Excel and database analysis)
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Knowledge of procurement and source to pay processes and solutions or equivalent experience
- 2+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Business communication skill in English and Hindi

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
- Experience in Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) Law
- Experience working in risk mitigation, compliance function, internal controls, legal, Human Rights compliance, labor employment, transportation or supply chain experience

title: Executive Assistant, Amazon Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Customer Service (CS) CXP (Customer Experience Products) team is seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant to support the Vice President in a fast-paced, strategic environment. CXP is a global, multi-disciplinary organization across product, engineering, science, data intelligence, and design, with broad accountability spanning customer experience, innovation, and business performance. Our ambition is to reinvent Customer Service with GenAI toward a future where Amazon CS is so good that it is a reason customers choose Amazon.

This role requires someone who is bright, self-motivated, and thrives under pressure while maintaining exceptional organizational standards. The EA will be a critical partner to the VP, enabling them to focus on the highest-priority work, and will serve as the lead EA for the broader CXP organization. The right person will develop a strong understanding of the organization, its leaders, priorities, and operating rhythms, and use that knowledge to improve decision velocity, communication flow, and execution.

The strongest EAs do more than execute tasks. They develop enough organizational understanding to exercise judgment on behalf of the executive they support, knowing the VP's priorities, leadership team, and working style well enough to make sound decisions independently rather than requiring direction for every one.

Key job responsibilities
Executive Calendar and Priority Management
- Own the VP's executive calendar with strategic prioritization across multiple time zones, balancing the purpose and urgency of competing requests rather than simply filling available time.
- Protect time for important, non-urgent work and build a calendar that is realistic for a human, including transition time, preparation, meals, and travel.
- Create coordination mechanisms across the VP's leadership team, the broader Customer Service Leadership Team, and senior executives.
- Develop enough organizational context to recommend appropriate delegates and minimize unnecessary rescheduling once commitments are made.
- Anticipate scheduling conflicts and resolve them proactively, maintaining alignment with VP priorities.
Organizational Coordination and Communication
- Serve as the connective tissue of the organization, ensuring information, decisions, and follow-up move efficiently across the VP, leadership team, and key stakeholders.
- Proactively surface important developments, anticipate coordination needs before they become blockers, and create clarity when ownership, timing, or next steps are ambiguous.
- Use the right communication channels with appropriate urgency, distinguishing what requires escalation from what can be resolved independently.
- Build strong working relationships with the VP's leadership team, peer EAs, and key partners across Amazon.
- Track important commitments and ensure appropriate follow-through.
Meetings, Events, and Team Experiences
- Plan and execute a range of meetings and events, including leadership offsites, workshops, planning sessions, employee engagement activities, and social events.
- Handle all event logistics, including venue, catering, room setup, transportation, and materials preparation, ensuring participants have what they need in advance.
- Coordinate schedules across multiple leaders and organizations, anticipating logistical issues before they arise.
- Partner with leaders and other EAs to create well-run, thoughtful experiences.
- Lead space planning for a large, globally distributed organization spanning multiple buildings and countries, including seating allocation, office moves, and reconfigurations as the organization evolves.
Travel, Expenses, and Executive Logistics
- Coordinate complex domestic and international travel, including multi-city itineraries, visa requirements, time zone optimization, and contingency planning, with practical attention to preparation and transition time.
- Manage changes and disruptions as they occur, and complete expense reports accurately and promptly.
Strategic Deliverables and Project Management
- Track and drive completion of key deliverables across the VP's portfolio, following up on action items from leadership meetings to ensure timely closure.
- Support ad hoc strategic projects with increased scope and visibility.
- Design and implement process improvements to maximize efficiency and scalability across the EA community and broader organization.


A day in the life
A typical day as the Lead Executive Assistant to the VP of CXP combines organizational excellence with hands-on problem-solving. You'll orchestrate a complex executive calendar across global time zones, keeping it aligned with the VP's highest priorities while protecting space for the thinking and preparation that high-stakes leadership requires. You'll coordinate high-visibility meetings with senior leaders across Customer Service and partner organizations, track critical deliverables, and ensure follow-through on commitments across a fast-moving leadership team.

You'll manage communications flow to and from the VP, surface important developments before they become problems, and help create clarity when ownership or next steps are ambiguous. Each day brings opportunities to solve complex logistical challenges, advance important organizational initiatives, and identify better ways for the leadership team to operate — not just managing the work around the organization, but actively helping the organization work better.


About the team
Amazon Customer Service CXP is a global, multi-disciplinary organization across product, engineering, science, data intelligence, and design. We are reinventing Customer Service with GenAI, building toward a future where Amazon CS is so effortless and effective that it becomes a reason customers choose Amazon. Our work spans the full breadth of the customer service experience: from the products and experiences customers interact with, to the AI and data systems that power them, to the business performance that makes it all sustainable.

We are builders, scientists, and operators who develop products, services, and data-driven solutions that shape how hundreds of millions of customers around the world get help. By eliminating friction and making support effortless, we enhance the overall customer experience while driving efficiency and innovation across Amazon's global operations.

We are also a dynamic group of leaders who are smart, customer-obsessed, and genuinely fun to work with. We take our mission seriously and our camaraderie seriously too. We are looking for a Lead EA who brings the same energy: a real passion for customer service, sharp instincts, hustle, warmth, and a sense of humor. If you thrive in a fast-moving environment, love solving complex problems, and want to be at the center of an organization doing meaningful work, this team is for you.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of senior level leadership support experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with C-level executive calendar management
- Experience as an Executive Assistant

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing teams
- Experience working in a matrixed organization

title: Embedded Controls Engineer, Power Loops
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Controls Engineer, Power Loops to develop and validate advanced control algorithms for SST power-conversion loops, with emphasis on stability, dynamic response and high-power converter behavior.

As a Controls Engineer, Power Loops you will develop and tune current/voltage/power loops (PI, MPC, passivity-based) with state-space models and stability analysis on a defined scope. You will secure stability margins and dynamic response, decoupling and disturbance rejection across operating points and converter paralleling. You will work with FPGA/DSP and embedded engineers to deploy loops in real time and correlates model predictions to lab measurement.

About AIS
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
Control development:
- Develop PI, model-predictive and passivity-based control approaches as appropriate to the converter.
- Build state-space models and perform stability analysis.
- Tune current, voltage and power loops for dynamic and steady-state performance.

Simulation & implementation:
- Use MATLAB/Simulink and Control Toolbox to design and evaluate control algorithms.
- Work with FPGA/DSP and embedded engineers to translate algorithms into real-time implementations.
- Correlate model predictions with laboratory measurements.

System behavior:
- Analyze dynamic load response relevant to variable AI compute workloads.
- Support converter paralleling, current sharing and fault-management strategies.
- Investigate instability, oscillation and transient-performance issues.

SST System Alignment:
- Design control loops to meet the system LVDC regulation targets (±1% static and ±3% dynamic, with ±0.5% switching ripple) and the specified overload/fault behavior.
- Develop control strategies for VRT/FRT, MVAC load acceptance/rejection, ESS coordination, redundancy and dynamic power sharing.

A day in the life
As a Controls Engineer, Power Loops, you'll focus on developing and refining control algorithms for solid-state transformer power-conversion systems. Your day might include building state-space models in MATLAB/Simulink to analyze system stability, collaborating with embedded and FPGA engineers to translate your algorithms into real-time implementations, and correlating your model predictions with laboratory measurements to validate performance.

You'll investigate dynamic responses under variable compute workloads, troubleshoot oscillation and transient-performance issues, and work to ensure our systems meet strict regulation targets. Beyond routine development, you'll contribute to solving system-level challenges like converter paralleling strategies and fault-management approaches that require creative problem-solving across multiple engineering disciplines.

About the team
We are the team that keeps the cloud running. AWS Infrastructure Services designs, plans, delivers, and operates all AWS global infrastructure—the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the services they depend on. Our team tackles some of the most complex engineering challenges, with thousands of variables impacting our systems. We collaborate closely with power-electronics specialists, embedded systems engineers, and hardware teams to develop solutions that scale across our worldwide data centers. We're building the next generation of power-conversion technology, and we're looking for collaborative problem-solvers who are excited about contributing to infrastructure that powers global innovation.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to celebrate our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related experience/ field.
- Experience with power-converter control and stability analysis and/or understanding of real-time implementation constraints.
- Experience documenting design decisions, assumptions, trade-offs, risks and technical specifications.
- Experience using engineering analysis and measured evidence to drive decisions.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering.
- 2+ years experience in power-converter control (modeling, discretization, tuning) with hardware validation.
- Demonstrated strong control-theory background and knowledge.
- Experience with MATLAB/Simulink and Control Toolbox.
- Demonstrated ability to work closely with power-electronics and embedded teams.
- Demonstrated operating effectively in a greenfield environment where standards and reference designs may require interpretation and adaptation.

title: Trust and Privacy TPM, Devices & Services Trust, Privacy, and Accessibility
descriptionHtml:
Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA) is responsible for maintaining and raising the trust bar for Amazon customers across 30+ Devices and Services. We offer horizontal services for builders to ensure trust, privacy, and accessibility is built into our products and services. We also build customer-facing capabilities that provide customers with control and transparency while reducing trust risks, and enable partner teams to innovate with appropriate guardrails for privacy, safety and appropriateness, creative content, fairness, veracity, security, and accessibility.

As we expand our scope into trust incident response and crisis management, we are growing the team to address trust risks across our devices and services portfolio. The TPA team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function. In this role, you will manage incident response for high-severity, trust-impacting events, from intake through containment, mitigation, and closure, operating the mechanisms, playbooks, and metrics that keep this an always-on operation. You will act as incident manager during active events, drive escalations with urgency, keep stakeholders aligned, and write clear briefs for senior leadership. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly protects customer trust across our products and services, and partners with our US-based incident leads to sustain continuous, cross-time-zone coverage.

A successful candidate will have a strong background driving cross-functional programs, solid program-management, technical problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable operating at a technical level with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should understand systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and support sound decisions, derive insights from complex data, write clear business documents, and hold partner teams accountable to shared commitments through to closure. The ability to stay detail-oriented and decisive under pressure will be critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end response for assigned trust-impacting incidents by defining scope and success criteria, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across dependent teams, and driving each case to closure within SLA.
- Set up incident rooms for high-severity events; triage, classify, escalate, and coordinate response under pressure using established severity matrices.
- Partner with engineering and product stakeholders to understand system architecture, data flows, and design trade-offs, ensuring remediation meets scalability, performance, and operational standards.
- Drive root-cause analysis and post-mortems (correction-of-error), track corrective and preventative actions across Engineering and Product through to closure, and prepare incident narratives, escalation briefs, and status updates for leadership.
- Evaluate opportunities to apply generative artificial intelligence tools and process improvements to streamline detection and triage workflows, while mentoring peers and contributing to team hiring efforts.

A day in the life
As a Technical Program Manager on the Trust Incident & Crisis Management team, you will work on high-impact, high-visibility programs that directly protect our customers. You start your day triaging newly reported issues across trust surfaces and picking up open incidents and corrective actions. During an active event you step into the incident-manager role: classify severity, coordinate the response, assign clear ownership for each action, and keep every item moving to closure within SLA. Between events you run post-incident reviews, keep playbooks and dashboards current, and partner with Engineering and Product to embed trust-by-design practices upstream. You collaborate across trust, privacy, accessibility, security, engineering, legal, and product teams to drive these programs from intake to resolution.

About the team
Our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function sits within Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA), building the programs and services at Amazon scale that grow customer trust, create mechanisms to meet evolving regulatory objectives, and ensure our partners can fulfill their trust obligations without disruption. We run a single, consistent, always-on operating model for high-severity, trust-impacting events: detection, coordination, containment, and crisis response. This is a newly expanded area of investment, so it is a great time to join and help shape how we build out this capability. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational rigor, and we support new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

You’ll be directly responsible for managing a team of Area Managers and their direct reports: meanwhile, you will report to the Senior Operations Manager of your Fulfillment Center. The quality of your leadership is key to success in this role: you’ll motivate and inspire your teams to do their best work, while planning schedules and activities that balance their needs with that of the business.
Another key aspect of your role will be to lead on numerous process improvement projects, with the aim of streamlining all activities, both for yourself and the team members you manage. The ideas, innovation and leaps out of the status quo that you come up with could very well be rolled out across the Amazon network: this immense opportunity is yours for the taking.






Key job responsibilities
Job Description
Your role will be pivotal in the overall management, control, organisation and direction of either Outbound, Inbound or Customer Returns operational areas of your FC. Your responsibilities will include, amongst others:
- Maintaining Health and Safety standards within your remit area, while promoting an inspiring Health and Safety culture on-site,
- Become a subject matter expert on specific, larger-scale processes and activities within FCs, such as 5S audits,
- In your inventory control and systems environment, you’ll manage timely data collection, updating operations metrics on an hourly basis,
- Therefore, you’ll aim to achieve productivity targets, reduce cost per unit, eliminate errors and ensure an excellent customer experience,
- Work closely with other support teams (HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety and Security, IT) on staffing plans, schedules and performance levels,
- Implement process change and contribute in cross-functional Six Sigma initiatives within your site and the broader Amazon EU Operations network,

A day in the life

A day in the life
You’ll lead a shift at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.

About the team
About the team
Customer Fulfilment or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Senior Manager, Applied Science, Amazon Business System Integrations
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by building technology that makes life easier for business customers? If you enjoy working at the center of enterprise commerce, connecting Amazon Business with the procurement, ERP, and finance systems that organizations run on ethn Amazon Business System (ABS) Integrations team is the place for you.

We build systems integrations capabilities that let business customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. This includes APIs, protocols, and partner connections that make procurement faster, more automated, and more reliable at global scale. Our teams design, launch, and operates these integrations with a wide range of partners, and each launch has to work securely and seamlessly across many different systems, regions, and customer needs.

We are seeking a Senior Manager Applied Science to build and lead the science organization in Amazon Business Systems Integrations. This is a foundational leadership role spanning the full integrations portfolio. This role will hire, grow, and lead a team of applied scientists who define how we measure and improve the performance of AI agents and human-AI teams. A core part of the role is defining the science agenda itself - identifying which problems are most worth solving and where the highest-leverage bets lie. Directions worth exploring might include Organizational Intelligence (turning institutional knowledge into agent-consumable skills) AI Agent Experience / AiAX (agent observability and autonomous remediation) and contextual behavioral security that adapts enforcement in real time for human and agent sessions and anything which the defines how we measure and improve agents and human-AI teams i.e benchmarks, task suites, and metrics (accuracy cost-per-task task completion productivity) that turn subjective "it works" judgments into rigorous reproducible measurement that gates what we ship. There are no established industry patterns in this field and the team will set the scientific direction, determine how AI agents and people perceive reason and act reliably within computing environments at enterprise scale.

This role requires building, leading and retaining a high calibre applied science team spanning the Agentic Integrations portfolio. This leader will set the bar for scientific talent, create the growth paths, and build the culture that makes Amazon Business a destination for the best agent and human-AI researchers.


Key job responsibilities
• Set the long-term scientific vision and team strategy: Define what best-in-class agent performance evaluation and learning look like across Agentic WorkSpaces - for computer-using agents and human-AI teams alike. Chart a multi-year research roadmap and build the team and plan to deliver it. Secure buy-in from VP-level leadership.
• Hire and grow scientific talent: Own recruiting calibration development and retention for the science team. Mentor scientists toward senior and principal scope and raise the scientific bar across the organization.
• Direct research on highly ambiguous novel problems: Guide the team through foundational challenges in agent perception reasoning evaluation reliability and human-AI collaboration - problems where neither the approach nor the success criteria are pre-defined.
• Drive cross-organizational alignment: Work across partner teams (AgentCore Bedrock model teams Identity Security the MCP ecosystem) and across the Applied AI Solutions product portfolio with product and engineering leadership to ensure scientific decisions compose into a coherent product.
• Deliver measurable business impact: Ensure your team's research translates to customer outcomes: higher task accuracy lower cost-per-action faster time-to-production measurable productivity for human-AI teams and the trust that lets enterprises scale agent workflows.
• Establish scientific rigor and operational excellence: Set the standard for experimentation evaluation and reproducibility and the mechanisms that keep the science organization productive and accountable.
• Advance the state of the art: Enable and champion contributions to the external technical community through publications patents and open-source work that position AWS as the leader in the science of secure agent-computer interaction and human-AI teamwork.
• Translate science into shipped product. Partner with engineering, product, and program leaders to move models evaluation and learning systems from prototype into a decade-old production service operating at massive scale without compromising the reliability that customers depend on.
• Represent science in leadership and to customers. Be the scientific voice in org-level planning and roadmap decisions across AAWS and engage directly with enterprise customers on how agent performance safety and human-AI productivity are measured and earned.

Basic qualifications

-Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, or equivalent
-Experience building large-scale machine learning and AI solutions at Internet scale
-Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives
-Experience hiring and leading experienced scientists as well as having a successful record of developing junior members from academia or industry to a successful career track

Preferred qualifications

-10+ years of practical work applying ML to solve complex problems for large-scale applications experience
-5+ years of hands-on work in big data, machine learning and predictive modeling experience
-5+ years of people management experience
-PhD in Computer Science (Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, or equivalent)
-Experience in practical work applying ML to solve complex problems for large scale applications
-Experience working with big data, machine learning and predictive modeling
-Experience in people management
-Experience with big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive etc.
-Experience with Java, C++, or other programming language, as well as with R, MATLAB, Python, or an equivalent scripting language
-Experience researching actual applications

title: Technical Infrastructure Project Manager - Networking, Network Deployment - Fulfilment Center Technology
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Network Deployment Services owns the planning, delivery, and lifecycle management of network infrastructure supporting Amazon's global fulfillment, transportation and grocery, sites. Our infrastructure enables reliable connectivity for Amazon's operations at scale and plays a critical role in supporting business growth, operational efficiency, and customer experience. The team is responsible for delivering network infrastructure programs across the full lifecycle, including hardware deployment, upgrades, capacity expansion, technology refresh, optimization, and decommissioning. We work closely with Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Field Deployment, Operations, and external vendors to deliver scalable, reliable, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions across Amazon's global network.
We are seeking a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) to lead large-scale network hardware deployment and lifecycle programs. The successful candidate will own program planning and execution, drive financial and commercial approvals, coordinate hardware procurement and field deployments, and ensure programs are delivered on time and within budget. This role requires strong program management fundamentals, the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and experience delivering complex infrastructure programs across cross-functional teams.


Key job responsibilities
• Program Ownership and Execution: Own end-to-end planning and delivery of network hardware lifecycle programs, including technology refresh, infrastructure upgrades, capacity expansion, and hardware replacement. Manage multiple programs in parallel, ensuring delivery against agreed schedules, budgets, and business requirements.
• Financial Planning and Approvals: Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to develop project cost estimates, prepare and secure Capital Authorization Request (CAR) approvals, track budget utilization, and manage financial risks and changes throughout the program lifecycle.
• Vendor and Commercial Management: Work with hardware vendors, suppliers, and internal procurement teams to obtain quotes, negotiate pricing, evaluate commercial proposals, and drive cost-effective procurement while meeting program timelines and technical requirements.
• Project Planning and Deployment Coordination: Develop detailed project plans, milestones, resource requirements, and deployment schedules. Coordinate with field deployment teams, engineering teams, vendors, and site stakeholders to ensure hardware deployments are executed as planned and dependencies are addressed proactively.
• Risk and Dependency Management: Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, resource constraints, and schedule deviations early. Establish mitigation plans, drive issue resolution, and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders to protect committed timelines.
• Stakeholder Management and Communication: Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Field Deployment, Operations, and external vendors. Provide clear and regular program updates to stakeholders and senior leadership, highlighting progress, risks, financial status, and decisions required.
• Metrics and Operational Excellence: Establish scalable mechanisms to track program milestones, deployment progress, financial performance, vendor commitments, and delivery risks. Use metrics to improve visibility, identify bottlenecks, reduce deployment cycle times, and drive continuous improvement.
• Process Improvement and Standardization: Identify opportunities to simplify program execution, standardize deployment processes, improve planning accuracy, and reduce manual effort across hardware lifecycle programs. Develop repeatable mechanisms that support increased deployment volume and operational scale.

Basic qualifications

- • 3+ years of program or project management experience.
- • Experience managing large-scale infrastructure deployment, hardware lifecycle, telecom, networking, data center, or IT infrastructure programs.
- • Experience managing project schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, budgets, and delivery commitments.
- • Experience coordinating across cross-functional teams, external vendors, and senior stakeholders.
- • Experience with financial planning, cost tracking, procurement, or commercial negotiations.
- • Experience using program metrics, reporting mechanisms, and project management tools to track execution and drive results.

Preferred qualifications

- • Experience managing large-scale network hardware deployment, infrastructure refresh, technology upgrade, or lifecycle management programs.
- • Familiarity with telecom and networking infrastructure, including routers, switches, WAN connectivity, and related network technologies.
- • Experience preparing business cases, securing capital approvals, and managing project budgets.
- • Experience negotiating vendor pricing and managing supplier commitments for infrastructure deployments.
- • Experience coordinating field deployment teams across multiple sites or geographic regions.
- • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
- • Experience simplifying processes, building scalable mechanisms, and driving continuous improvement.

title: SDE, Constellation Operations, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

As a Software Development Engineer you will own the development, implementation, and test of operational tooling built to execute the Leo mission. You will work with engineering teams across ground and space systems, to understand how the system functions and deliver an integrated solution to prepare for and execute the mission. Because of the scale of the mission, you will be focused on tooling that supports and enables the Mission Operations team — identifying areas of improvement and initiating changes to improve the productivity of the fleet.

You will prepare for each launch and on-orbit demonstration, design and conduct operational tests, and drive automation efforts with scalability in mind, ensuring that the constellation functions at peak performance with limited manual intervention. You work alongside flight directors and Leo software teams to design and implement operational improvements and tooling, develop and perform analysis on system data, and identify areas and mechanisms for further improvement.

The ideal candidate will be detail oriented, have strong organizational skills, able to work independently, juggle multiple tasks at once, and maintain professionalism under pressure. You should have deep knowledge software engineering practices, understand how software and hardware systems interact, and can drive design and implementation of operational execution of objectives in complex systems. Familiarity with space systems is desired.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience in Space Vehicle/Satellite Operations, Space Communications or related industry

title: UX Researcher Intern – Summer 2027
descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

This is a summer only internship, taking place between May/June and August/September 2027. Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions. Interns should expect to work in office, Monday through Friday, up to 40 hours per week, typically between 8am and 5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Students should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon workday.

Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter, semester, or trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes. By applying to this position, your application will be considered for all UX Designer Intern roles at the locations we hire for across the United States.

You will be able to provide your preference of location and start date during the application process, but we cannot guarantee that we can meet your selection based on several factors, including but not limited to the availability and business needs of this role. Finalization of the available locations and start dates will be provided to you at the time of job offer.

As a UX Research Intern you will need to think strategically, be creative, and negotiate design solutions in relation to business goals. Help collect and analyze user behavior through lab studies, field visits, ethnography, surveys, benchmark studies, server logs and online experiments. You will identify and incorporate complex technical and business requirements into research and help advocate research findings to diverse audiences through written reports and in-person presentations.

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Key job responsibilities
• Define and execute a comprehensive research plan
• Identify best method or mix of quantitative and qualitative methods based on priorities, research questions, timeline, and resourcing
• Design, conduct, and analyze results from 1-3 studies including usability lab studies, remote research, field studies, and survey design
• Identify best method or mix of quantitative and qualitative methods based on priorities, research questions, timeline, and resourcing

A day in the life
Our internship program provides hands-on learning and building experiences for students who are interested in a career in UX research. In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in fun activities with other interns throughout the summer. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your internship and learn in a real-world setting.

Design at Amazon has been growing steadily in reach and impact, spanning devices to fashion, delivery logistics to search and streaming video, and voice and sound to physical retail, all while creating and cultivating experiences that touch Amazon customers everywhere, every day. Amazon design teams include every flavor of UI, UX, visual, motion, illustration, brand, and marketing design, as well as design technologists, researchers, writers, and more. Check out https://amazon.design/, and come build the future with us.

Basic qualifications

- Are enrolled in a academic program that is physically located in the United States
- Are 18 years of age or older
- Work 40 hours/week minimum and commit to 12 week internship maximum
- Have at least two creative materials for Amazon to review. They can be in any format (i.e. website, PDF, slide deck, etc.)
- Experience reviewing user research and data to build a strategic and user-friendly design
- Currently working towards a Master's Degree or above in Human-Centered Interaction, Statistics, Psychology, Design, Computer Science, or other equivalent discipline, with an expected conferral date between December 2027 – June 2028.
- Able to relocate nationwide - relocation assistance provided if eligible

Preferred qualifications

- Experience user research or other experience from a technical field, such as software development, systems management, or similar
- Have a portfolio demonstrating past work experience and deliverables (e.g., study plans, reports, personas)
- Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal and analytical skills; the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and persuasively across different audiences and varying levels of the organization
- A passion and capacity to advocate on behalf of our users.
- Creative Materials Guidance:
- Show your thinking: Include at least two projects indicating the problem you were trying to solve, your design process, early design iterations, the final implemented design. We want to see your approach.
- Pay attention to detail: A submission is a visual story-telling (beginning, middle, and end). Have a clear visual hierarchy, consistent spacing and alignment, and show your intention behind your decision.
- Be customer-centric: Explain who your customer is, their unmet needs, how you validated or invalidated your assumptions about your customer, and how your design addresses their needs.

title: B2B Content Creator, Ring Business
descriptionHtml:
Join the Amazon Key and Ring teams in shaping the future of home and business security. We’re seeking a B2B Content Creator to produce the customer stories, social content, and blog posts that bring Ring Business to life. You’ll own hands-on content creation end to end — writing, shooting, and editing — turning real customer outcomes into platform-native stories that build awareness, trust, and pipeline. This is a maker’s role: you write, you shoot, you edit, you ship — self-sufficient, with AI as a force multiplier.

Key job responsibilities
• Produce B2B customer stories and case studies — interview customers, draft the narrative, and adapt each into blog, social, and sales-enablement formats
• Write and publish B2B blog posts aligned to the content calendar, search intent, and the Ring Business messaging framework
• Create social-native content for LinkedIn and owned channels — long-form posts, multi-image and document carousels, and short-form video
• Shoot and edit video end to end — self-sufficient from capture through post-production, using AI video tools to produce and localize at speed without external agencies
• Maintain a consistent Ring Business brand voice across every market and channel
• Partner on the rolling content calendar, aligning each piece to a clear business goal

A day in the life
This role is hands-on content craft with a commercial edge. You’ll sit between the positioning and messaging work upstream and the campaigns that deploy downstream — taking a customer conversation and turning it into a story that runs on LinkedIn, the blog, and in sales decks. About the team
The Amazon Key team sits within the Amazon Devices team alongside Ring and other Home Security teams. Key is a uniquely cross-functional team within Amazon, and often serves as the connective tissue between Smart Home/Devices, Logistics, Operations, and Retail/Shopping. We are the bridge between device management and physical services, and our team indexes highly on ownership and collaboration. We have lots of stakeholders, and we have relentlessly high standards for our high-visibility programs.

- 5+ years of content creation or similar experience
- Portfolio of published customer stories, blog posts, and social-native content

- Working knowledge of LinkedIn-first B2B formats, SEO/search intent, and content-calendar ownership
- Hands-on experience with AI video and creative tools for production, editing, and localization at scale

title: Pre-Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Preconstruction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's owner's representative during the preconstruction phase — responsible for independently managing difficult, cross-functional industrial building projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution across your assigned region. Preconstruction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You are responsible as the project manager to lead planning, design, and preconstruction projects — including new built-to-suit industrial buildings, tenant improvements, extensions of existing facilities, and renovation projects — supporting Amazon's logistics network infrastructure.

You work independently within your assigned region, using your knowledge of construction and project management concepts to decide which actions to take to complete projects, and seeking guidance as needed on strategic components. You are tactical with some strategic components, utilizing well-defined processes and best practices to facilitate delivery of high-quality results. You make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to keep projects on track.

Key competencies of this position include ensuring that contracted resources deliver work product in support of project durations, permitting, key performance indicators (KPIs), and quality documentation; managing project teams (developers, design engineers, professional consultants); influencing internal teams (Design Engineering, Amazon Robotics); contract management governance; conceptual estimating and budget oversight; and managing multiple large industrial projects in various locations simultaneously. Translating technical documents and information into clear, concise narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers is essential.

This opportunity combines construction engineering, planning, project management, real estate development, design validation, site visits, understanding of local building and fire code issues, utilities, sustainability, multi-disciplinary design management, and contract management. The Preconstruction Manager is responsible for the planning and design of scope, budget, and schedule prior to handing off to the Construction Manager — focusing on taking ownership to resolve upstream issues and supporting the construction team throughout the process.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Supervise the implementation and management of Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the planning and preconstruction phases of a project
- Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals
- Review noise, traffic, and environmental studies; understand zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements for assigned projects

Preconstruction & Project Management
- Independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution
- Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — coordinating with design teams to develop site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
- Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously
- Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately
- Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean handoff to the Construction Manager; remain a key support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability
- Minimize disruptions and proactively mitigate risks; plan ahead to prevent problems before they happen

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Develop and manage project budgets and costs; own comprehensive schedule management and cashflow forecasting across assigned preconstruction projects
- Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; negotiate the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants
- Contribute to the selection of external vendor partners and manage vendor procurement; oversee professional service providers to ensure their skills and competencies meet project requirements
- Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms
- Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement
- Identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project handover to Amazon stakeholders; make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Work with internal and external teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
- Drive results through communicating, weighing risks, making decisions, leading, and influencing; competently represent project and technical information to diverse audiences
- Maintain good working relationships with stakeholders and vendors; lead constructive dialogue to resolve and prevent project issues
- Act as the primary escalation point for project team members; own and track issues to ensure they are addressed, documented, and resolved

Communication & Reporting
- Prepare and present project status and risk reports; provide clear, concise summaries for projects under your ownership to leadership and management teams
- Translate technical documents and information into end-to-end narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers
- Run preconstruction meetings effectively — putting the right people in the room, checking progress, and driving high-level alignment and consensus
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners; trusted to present decisions to leaders up to 2-3 tiers above level
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project developments
- Represent Amazon's interests in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

Process Improvement & Innovation
- Optimize preconstruction processes and implement improvements in procedures and playbooks to improve project efficiency and delivery
- Look for opportunities to improve operational excellence and influence the team to determine where to iterate and make improvements
- Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the preconstruction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices
- Adapt to constant change and innovation; find adaptable solutions for an evolving business

A day in the life
Each day, you represent GES NA Design & Construction as Amazon's owner during the preconstruction phase — navigating uncertainty, proactively unblocking project barriers, and influencing the best project decisions. You are tactical with some strategic components, working independently and interacting with leadership to resolve issues. Your day may include:
- Coordinating with architects, engineers, and design consultants on design document development, scope changes, and project status
- Reviewing site plans, composite floor plans, and design documents for compliance with Amazon's standards and operational requirements
- Negotiating contract terms with developers, contractors, and consultants while driving adherence to schedules and budgets
- Coordinating with AHJ on permitting status, zoning, fire code, and building code requirements
- Preparing and presenting project status and risk reports for leadership
- Partnering with Real Estate and Transaction teams on entitlement strategy and long-lead procurement
- Providing estimating support, interpreting drawings, contributing to budgets, and reviewing lease exhibits
- Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information
- Supporting the Construction Manager on active construction projects with preconstruction expertise

About the team
At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's Project Management Representative, or in a related commercial development or construction discipline
- 5+ years of project management experience from design phase through implementation and operation, including negotiating construction, procurement, and labor contracts
- Experience within packaging, processing, or logistical facilities with complex equipment, or comparable experience
- Position includes travel up to 60% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree or certification in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration
- Experience operating across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or Owner's Project Management)
- Demonstrated capability in planning, design review, implementation, and project management/control of new structures and enhancement of existing facilities
- Experience managing multi-disciplinary design incorporating industrial automation, robotics, or similar
- Strong influencing and negotiating skills
- Demonstrated success communicating project requirements to diverse audiences (e.g., senior management, peers, fire marshals, utility providers, public officials, vendors)
- Knowledge of Building Information Modeling (BIM)
- CMIT/CMAA or PMP certification or equivalent
